Around the same time, a high school girl goes missing, and small details from these rides start pointing back toward Odokawa, until crooked cops and gangsters alike are watching him. OLM and P.I.C.S. produced this original 13-episode series in 2021. Much of it plays out through conversation, and it contains some violence.

nekomonogatari-kuro.summary: Set shortly before the events of Bakemonogatari, this story follows Koyomi Araragi shortly after his brush with a vampire over spring break. He runs into his class president, Tsubasa Hanekawa, and notices a bandage on her face that she brushes off. Together they find a tailless white cat killed on the road and bury it, and soon afterwards Hanekawa starts behaving like someone else entirely. Araragi turns to the specialist Meme Oshino for answers. Shaft adapted this part of Nisio Isin's Monogatari light novels as four episodes broadcast back to back on 31 December 2012. Contains fan service, some violence and themes of family neglect.
nekomonogatari-kuro.notes: Wikipedia source is the Monogatari episode list, which covers the 31 Dec 2012 broadcast.

hinamatsuri.summary: Yoshifumi Nitta is a rising yakuza member whose real passion is collecting expensive vases. One evening a large metal capsule appears out of nowhere in his apartment, and inside is Hina, an expressionless girl with powerful telekinesis. She needs to use her powers regularly or they flare up dangerously, so Nitta reluctantly takes her in, feeding her, enrolling her in school and paying for the damage. More people with similar powers turn up, each causing fresh trouble for the people who take them in. Feel adapted Masao Ohtake's manga into 12 episodes in spring 2018. It is a deadpan comedy with occasional quieter, touching episodes.

the-tatami-galaxy.summary: An unnamed third-year student at a university in Kyoto looks back on two wasted years. He arrived dreaming of a rosy campus life, but every club he joined led to trouble, usually thanks to Ozu, a grinning friend who seems to exist to cause chaos. He also never found the nerve to speak honestly to Akashi, a calm younger student he likes. Each episode replays his student years after a different choice of club, with recurring characters and an odd fortune teller showing up along the way. Madhouse adapted Tomihiko Morimi's novel into 11 episodes in 2010, directed by Masaaki Yuasa. It is told in rapid-fire narration with a distinctive visual style.

hajimete-no-gal.summary: Junichi Hashiba is a high school student desperate to get a girlfriend, and his equally hopeless friends push him into asking out a gal, the flashy, fashionable type of girl they assume will say yes. Under pressure he picks Yukana Yame, a popular girl at his school. To his surprise, she agrees to go out with him. The series follows the awkward and often embarrassing early days of their relationship, as Junichi struggles with his nerves and his imagination while Yukana proves more serious about him than he expected. NAZ adapted Meguru Ueno's manga into 10 episodes in summer 2017. Contains frequent sexual humour and fan service.

pokemon.summary: In a world where people catch and train creatures called Pokémon, ten-year-old Ash Ketchum of Pallet Town leaves home hoping to become the greatest trainer of all, a Pokémon Master. He oversleeps on the day he is meant to choose his first partner and ends up with a stubborn Pikachu that refuses to ride in its Poké Ball. Joined along the way by Misty and Brock, Ash travels from town to town, battling gym leaders for badges and meeting new Pokémon, while the bumbling Team Rocket trio keeps trying to steal Pikachu. OLM's series, based on the Pokémon video games, ran for 276 episodes from 1997 to 2002 and was followed by Advanced Generation. It is suitable for children.
pokemon.notes: This Kitsu entry is the original 1997-2002 series only (276 episodes); later series have their own entries.

asobi-asobase.summary: Three middle school girls start a club devoted to playing games. Hanako Honda is the loud, energetic one from a wealthy family; Olivia looks like a foreigner but grew up in Japan and cannot actually speak English; and Kasumi Nomura is a quiet girl who hates losing and wants help with her English. Their after-school pastimes, from simple playground games to made-up contests, quickly spiral into shouting, scheming and absurd escalations. Lerche adapted Rin Suzukawa's manga into 12 episodes in summer 2018. Despite its soft, cute look, it is a loud sketch comedy known for exaggerated faces and some crude humour.

otome-game-no-hametsu-flag-shika-nai-aku.summary: When eight-year-old Catarina Claes, daughter of a noble family, hits her head, she suddenly remembers her past life as a Japanese high school girl who loved games. She realises she has been reborn as the villainess of Fortune Lover, a romance game from her old life, and that every route ends with Catarina exiled or killed. Determined to survive, she starts preparing in her own odd ways, from farming to sword practice, and tries to stay on good terms with the game's love interests and its heroine. Silver Link adapted Satoru Yamaguchi's light novels into 12 episodes in spring 2020, followed by a second season. It is a lighthearted comedy.

sayonara-no-asa-ni-yakusoku-no-hana-wo-k.summary: Maquia belongs to the Iorph, a secluded people who stop ageing in their teens and live for centuries, spending their days weaving cloth that records their history. She is an orphan and feels alone even among her own kind. When a kingdom's soldiers attack her home on dragonback, Maquia is swept away and stranded in the human world. There she finds a baby boy whose family has been killed, names him Ariel and decides to raise him herself, even though she will stay young while he grows up. Mari Okada wrote and directed this P.A. Works film, released in February 2018 as her directorial debut. It contains some war violence.

takopii-no-genzai.summary: Takopi is a small octopus-like alien from the Happy Planet who has come to Earth to spread happiness. Weak with hunger soon after landing, he is fed by Shizuka Kuze, a fourth-grade girl who rarely smiles. Takopi decides to repay her by cheering her up with the gadgets he brought from home. But Shizuka is bullied at school by a classmate named Marina and largely left alone at home, and Takopi, who knows nothing about human cruelty, struggles to understand why his tools do not fix anything. Enishiya adapted Taizan 5's web manga as a six-episode online series in summer 2025. Contains child abuse, bullying, suicide and violence.

hajime-no-ippo.summary: Ippo Makunouchi is a shy high school student who spends his free time helping his mother run their fishing boat rental business, and classmates bully him constantly. After one beating, he is rescued by Mamoru Takamura, a talented boxer who brings him to his own gym, the Kamogawa, to patch him up. Watching boxing for the first time, Ippo starts wondering what it means to be strong, and he asks the gruff veteran coach Genji Kamogawa to train him. His hard work and stubborn nature soon lead him toward a professional career and serious rivals. Madhouse adapted George Morikawa's manga from 2000 to 2002, and later series continued the story.
hajime-no-ippo.notes: MAL lists 75 episodes, Wikipedia 76, so the summary gives years only.

hellsing.summary: The Hellsing Organization is a secret British agency that hunts vampires and ghouls, led by the stern Sir Integra Hellsing. Its strongest weapon is Alucard, a vampire of enormous power who serves the Hellsing family. On a mission to a village overrun by the undead, Alucard crosses paths with Seras Victoria, a young police officer caught up in the attack, and she ends up joining the agency as a fledgling vampire under his watch. The team then faces a growing number of artificial vampires as well as rival forces. Gonzo adapted Kouta Hirano's manga into 13 episodes from 2001 to 2002, telling an original story. Contains graphic violence and gore.

hikaru-ga-shinda-natsu.summary: In a small mountain village, teenager Yoshiki Tsujinaka has grown up with his best friend Hikaru Indou. Months ago, Hikaru went missing in the mountains for a week and came back seemingly unchanged, but Yoshiki cannot shake the feeling that something is wrong. When he finally asks, the thing wearing Hikaru's face admits it is not really him, and pleads with Yoshiki to let it stay by his side. Yoshiki agrees, even as strange and frightening things begin happening around the village. CygamesPictures adapted Mokumokuren's web manga into 12 episodes in summer 2025, with a second season announced. Contains horror imagery and disturbing themes.

oreimo.summary: Kyosuke Kosaka is an ordinary high school boy who barely talks to his younger sister Kirino. She is a fashion model, a top student and an athlete, and she treats him with open disdain. Then Kyosuke picks up a dropped DVD case in their entrance hall and finds an adult game about little sisters inside. It belongs to Kirino, who turns out to be a devoted otaku hiding her hobby from everyone. Sworn to secrecy, Kyosuke ends up as her reluctant adviser, helping her find otaku friends and keep her two lives apart. AIC adapted Tsukasa Fushimi's light novels into 12 episodes in 2010, followed by web episodes and a second season. Contains sexual themes and fan service.

netoge-no-yome-wa-onnanoko-ja-nai-to-omo.summary: Hideki Nishimura once asked a female character to marry him in an MMO and learned that the player was a man. Embarrassed, he swore never to believe that anyone online was really a girl. Now in high school and still playing, a guildmate's character named Ako keeps insisting she is his wife, and he reluctantly goes along with it. When the guild arranges to meet offline, every member proves to be a girl, Ako among them, and she goes to his school. The trouble is that Ako struggles to tell the game from real life, so the guild sets out to help her. Project No.9 adapted Shibai Kineko's light novels into 12 episodes in 2016. Contains fan service.

lucky-star.summary: Konata Izumi is a high school girl who would rather spend her nights on anime, games and manga than on homework. Her friends are the Hiiragi twins, sharp-tongued Kagami and gentle, scatterbrained Tsukasa, plus Miyuki Takara, a polite girl who seems to know about everything. There is almost no story to follow: the show is made of their conversations about food, school, holidays and otaku culture, the small arguments of everyday life and plenty of anime references. Each episode closes with Lucky Channel, a mini talk show whose two hosts get along badly. Kyoto Animation adapted Kagami Yoshimizu's four-panel manga into 24 episodes in 2007.

grisaia-no-kajitsu.summary: Yuji Kazami transfers to Mihama Academy hoping for an ordinary school life. The school turns out to be anything but ordinary: apart from Yuji, it has only five students, all girls, and each has her own reason for being there. As he settles into dormitory life, Yuji gets to know the sharp-tongued Yumiko, the older, teasing Amane, the cheerful Michiru, the young Makina and the class president Sachi, and gradually learns about the painful pasts they carry. Yuji has a few unusual skills and secrets of his own. Eight Bit adapted Frontwing's adult visual novel into 13 episodes in late 2014. Contains sexual content, violence and themes of trauma and suicide.

watashi-no-shiawase-na-kekkon.summary: In a Japan that resembles the early twentieth century, some noble families pass down supernatural gifts. Miyo Saimori was born without one, and since her mother's death she has been treated like a servant by her father, her stepmother and Kaya, the half-sister the family dotes on. When her father arranges for her to marry Kiyoka Kudo, a young army commander rumoured to be so cold that every previous bride-to-be has fled, Miyo goes expecting nothing. Instead, life in his household slowly begins to change her. Kinema Citrus adapted Akumi Agitogi's novels into 12 episodes in summer 2023, with a second season in 2025. Contains depictions of emotional and physical abuse.

citrus.summary: Yuzu Aihara is a fashionable, outgoing girl who has to switch schools when her mother remarries. Her new school is a strict, traditional all-girls academy, and on her first day she clashes with Mei, the stern, aloof student council president, who confiscates her phone. That evening Yuzu discovers that Mei is her new stepsister and will be living in the same room. Mei's unpredictable advances leave Yuzu confused about her own feelings, and the two have to sort out what they are to each other while dealing with school politics and family pressure. Passione adapted Saburouta's yuri manga into 12 episodes in early 2018. Contains sexual content, including unwanted kisses.

daemons-of-the-shadow-realm.summary: Yuru is a sixteen-year-old hunter from Higashi Village, a remote mountain settlement cut off from modern life. He spends his days hunting in the forest, while his twin sister Asa lives shut away inside the village, visited only by a select few. One day, armed outsiders arrive in force and attack. In the chaos, Yuru awakens a pair of ancient guardians called Daemons, and he learns that the world outside the mountains is very different from what he was told. He leaves home to find out the truth about Asa. Bones Film adapted Hiromu Arakawa's manga into 24 episodes from April to September 2026, with a second season announced. Contains violence.

xian-wang-de-richang-shenghuo.summary: In a modern China where people cultivate spiritual power, Wang Ling looks like an unremarkable high school student. In truth he has been impossibly strong since birth, so strong that his power could destroy the world, and he wears a talisman to keep it in check. All he really wants is a quiet, normal school life. That is hard to manage when the talisman keeps weakening, classmates and rivals keep causing trouble, and he has to fix problems without anyone noticing what he can do. Haoliners Animation produced this Chinese donghua, based on Kuxuan's web novel, as a 15-episode web series on Bilibili in 2020, with further seasons following.

jaku-chara-tomozaki-kun.summary: Fumiya Tomozaki is ranked first in Japan in the online fighting game Attack Families, but in daily life he is a loner who sees himself as a bottom-tier character with no hope. When he agrees to meet the second-ranked player in person, it turns out to be Aoi Hinami, the most popular and seemingly perfect girl in his class. Aoi insists that life is the best game of all and that its rules can be learned, so she starts giving Tomozaki daily assignments, from talking to classmates to improving his posture. Project No.9 adapted Yuki Yaku's light novels into 12 episodes in early 2021, with a second season in 2024.

yubisaki-to-renren.summary: Yuki Itose is a university student who has been deaf since birth. She communicates by signing, writing notes and texting, and her days follow a quiet routine with her best friend Rin. On a train one day she meets Itsuomi Nagi, an older student and friend of Rin's who travels widely and speaks several languages. Itsuomi is curious rather than awkward about her deafness and wants to learn sign language so they can talk properly. As they spend time together, Yuki's world starts to grow. Ajia-do adapted Suu Morishita's manga into 12 episodes in early 2024. It is a gentle romance that pays close attention to how its characters communicate.

plunderer.summary: In the world of Alcia, everyone carries a number on their body called a Count, which tracks something tied to their life, such as distance walked. If a person's Count drops to zero, they are dragged down into the Abyss. Hina, a girl whose Count measures how far she has travelled, has been wandering in search of a legendary hero known as an Ace, as her mother asked. Her search leads her to Licht, a swordsman who acts like a lecherous fool but seems to be hiding a great deal. Geek Toys adapted Suu Minazuki's manga into 24 episodes in 2020. Contains fan service and violence.

seirei-gensouki.summary: Rio is an orphan living in the slums of a royal capital, driven by the memory of his mother's murder. One day he suddenly gains the memories of Haruto Amakawa, a Japanese university student who died in an accident, and the two personalities merge into one. Along with that he wakes up to magical abilities. When he rescues a kidnapped princess, he is rewarded with a place at the kingdom's royal academy, where the noble students look down on him. Rio has to navigate a world of status and politics while holding onto his goal. TMS Entertainment adapted Yuri Kitayama's light novels into 12 episodes in summer 2021, followed by a second season in 2024.

to-love-ru.summary: Rito Yuki is a shy high school boy who has liked his classmate Haruna Sairenji for years but has never managed to tell her. One evening, while he is in the bath, a girl appears out of nowhere with no clothes on. She is Lala Satalin Deviluke, princess of a galactic empire, who has run away to escape the suitors her father keeps lining up. Through a misunderstanding Lala decides Rito wants to marry her, and soon alien bodyguards, rival suitors and more girls are crowding into his life. Xebec adapted Saki Hasemi and Kentaro Yabuki's manga into 26 episodes in 2008. It is a harem comedy with heavy fan service and nudity.

genjitsu-shugi-yuusha-no-oukoku-saikenki.summary: Kazuya Souma is summoned to the struggling Elfrieden Kingdom as a hero, but he learns that the king plans to hand him over to a powerful empire as part of a wartime deal. Kazuya instead presents a practical plan for repairing the country's finances, food supply and infrastructure. The impressed king steps aside, makes Kazuya ruler and engages him to Princess Liscia. Lacking any fighting power, Kazuya relies on economics, administration and talented recruits as he reshapes the kingdom and deals with nobles who resist him. J.C.Staff adapted Dojyomaru's light novels in two parts, the first of 13 episodes airing in summer 2021. It focuses on politics more than battles.

slime-taoshite-300-nen-shiranai-uchi-ni-.summary: Azusa Aizawa works herself to death at a Japanese office job. In her next life, a goddess grants her wish for a calm existence, and she is reborn as an immortal witch who never ages past seventeen, living in a cottage beside a highland village. To pay her way she defeats a few slimes every day, and after three centuries of this she has quietly reached the maximum level. Once word spreads, challengers come knocking, starting with a young dragon, and her peaceful household keeps growing into an unusual found family. Revoroot adapted Kisetsu Morita's light novels into 12 episodes in spring 2021, with a second season in 2025. It is a gentle comedy.

ore-wo-suki-nano-wa-omae-dake-ka-yo.summary: Amatsuyu Kisaragi, nicknamed Joro, presents himself as a friendly, easygoing second-year student, though privately he is far more calculating. When two girls ask him out on the same weekend, the student council president Cosmos and his childhood friend Himawari, he thinks his luck has changed. Instead, both confess they love his best friend Sun-chan, the star of the baseball team, and ask Joro to help them. Meanwhile the only person who seems interested in him is Pansy, a gloomy, sharp-tongued library girl he can't stand. Connect adapted Rakuda's light novels into 12 episodes in late 2019. It is a romantic comedy full of misunderstandings.

blood-lad.summary: Staz is a vampire who controls a district of the Demon World, and the demons beneath him think of him as a feared boss. Privately he is a devoted fan of Japanese otaku culture, more interested in manga and games than in blood. When Fuyumi Yanagi, a regular schoolgirl from Japan, wanders through a portal into his territory, Staz is thrilled to meet a real human. Before he can get to know her, an accident leaves Fuyumi a ghost, and Staz vows to find a way to bring her back to life, a quest that takes him across the Demon World. Brain's Base adapted Yuuki Kodama's manga into 10 episodes in 2013. Contains violence and some fan service.

golden-kamuy.summary: After the Russo-Japanese War, veteran Saichi Sugimoto, nicknamed Immortal Sugimoto for surviving battle after battle, is panning for gold in Hokkaido to keep a promise to a fallen comrade's family. He hears a tale of a huge stash of Ainu gold hidden by a man now held in Abashiri Prison, who supposedly tattooed a map to it across the bodies of fellow inmates before they escaped. Sugimoto teams up with Asirpa, a young Ainu girl skilled at hunting and survival, and the pair race rival treasure seekers, including a rogue army unit. Geno Studio adapted Satoru Noda's manga, beginning with 12 episodes in spring 2018. Contains graphic violence and gore.

lovely-complex.summary: At an Osaka high school, Risa Koizumi is unusually tall for a girl and Atsushi Otani is unusually short for a boy. Every time they open their mouths they end up bickering, so their classmates treat them like a comedy double act. When each develops a crush on someone new, they make a deal to help one another, though neither is very good at romance. As the school year goes on, Risa begins to see Otani differently, and figuring out what to do about it becomes a long, funny and sometimes painful process. Toei Animation adapted Aya Nakahara's manga into 24 episodes in 2007. It is a romantic comedy with plenty of slapstick and Kansai banter.

shoujo-shuumatsu-ryokou.summary: Two girls, Chito and Yuuri, ride a small tracked motorbike through the ruins of a vast, layered city long after civilisation has collapsed. Snow covers everything, other people are almost impossible to find, and their days revolve around scavenging food, fuel and anything else useful left behind. Chito is serious and bookish, Yuuri is carefree and always hungry, and as they slowly climb toward the upper levels they talk about the old world, find strange machines and make small discoveries together. White Fox adapted Tsukumizu's web manga into 12 episodes in late 2017. It is quiet and slow, balancing gentle humour with a melancholy, end-of-the-world mood.

musaigen-no-phantom-world.summary: In a near-future Japanese city, an accident released a virus that changed how human brains work, and people began seeing phantoms, spirits and creatures that had apparently been around all along. Some children born afterwards developed special abilities. High school student Haruhiko Ichijo can trap phantoms by sketching them, and he works with the hot-headed Mai Kawakami and other classmates in a school club that takes on phantom-related jobs, joined by the little phantom Ruru. Most episodes are self-contained adventures. Kyoto Animation adapted Soichiro Hatano's light novels into 13 episodes in early 2016. Contains fan service.

yagate-kimi-ni-naru.summary: Yuu Koito has always loved romance in manga and songs, so when a boy confesses to her at the end of middle school she expects to feel something and is troubled when she doesn't. Starting high school, she happens to see Touko Nanami, the admired student council president, turning down a boy just as calmly. Thinking they share the same problem, Yuu opens up to her, and Touko unexpectedly tells Yuu that she has fallen for her. Yuu agrees to help on the student council, and the two work on reviving a school stage play while their relationship slowly takes shape. TROYCA adapted Nio Nakatani's yuri manga into 13 episodes in late 2018.

nagi-no-asukara.summary: Long ago, humanity lived beneath the sea, and some people still do in Shioshishio, a village on the ocean floor whose residents can breathe underwater. When their school closes, four friends from the village, hot-headed Hikari, timid Manaka, steady Chisaki and calm Kaname, have to attend a middle school on land, where sea people and land people have long distrusted each other. There they meet Tsumugu, a quiet boy from a fishing family, and the group soon gets caught up in an old festival, changing feelings among them and tensions between the two communities. P.A. Works produced this original 26-episode series from 2013 to 2014.

death-march-kara-hajimaru-isekai-kyousou.summary: Ichiro Suzuki is a 29-year-old programmer buried in deadline crunch. He finally catches some sleep and wakes in a fantasy world that resembles the games he was building, with a younger body and the name Satou, which he used while testing. In a panic he uses a one-time emergency spell that wipes out an attacking army and sends his level soaring. Hiding how strong he is, Satou decides to travel and see the sights, and he gradually gathers companions, including a group of girls he takes under his protection. Silver Link and Connect adapted Hiro Ainana's light novels into 12 episodes in early 2018. Contains fan service.

sonny-boy.summary: One summer day, a middle school building and thirty-six of its students are suddenly cut off from the world and left drifting in an empty void. Some students develop strange powers, and the class quickly splits as the student council tries to impose rules and others refuse to follow them. Nagara, a quiet boy who would prefer to stay out of things, finds himself pulled along with the outspoken Nozomi and the solitary Mizuho as they discover that each new world they reach runs on its own odd logic. Madhouse produced this original 12-episode series in 2021, with Shingo Natsume as writer and director. It is surreal and introspective, often leaving viewers to fill gaps.

tenkuu-shinpan.summary: High school student Yuri Honjo suddenly finds herself on the roof of a skyscraper in a city of towers joined by rope bridges, with no way down and no idea how she got there. Masked figures stalk the rooftops and try to kill anyone they find, and some victims are pushed to take their own lives. Yuri learns that her older brother Rika is also somewhere in this world, and she decides to survive long enough to find him, teaming up with a calm, deadly schoolgirl named Mayuko along the way. Zero-G adapted Tsuina Miura and Takahiro Oba's manga as a 12-episode Netflix series in 2021. Contains graphic violence, gore, suicide and fan service.

kimi-no-koto-ga-dai-dai-dai-dai-daisuki-.summary: Rentaro Aijo has been turned down by a hundred girls in a row. At a shrine, the God of Love explains that a heavenly mistake has given him exactly one hundred soulmates, all of whom he will meet in high school. The catch is serious: any destined girl who does not end up with him will meet with a fatal run of bad luck. Rentaro decides the only honest answer is to date every one of them, openly and sincerely, starting with the first two he meets. Each new girlfriend brings her own exaggerated personality to the chaos. Bibury Animation Studios adapted Rikito Nakamura and Yukiko Nozawa's manga into 12 episodes in late 2023, with later seasons. Contains fan service.

gangsta.summary: In the crime-ridden city of Ergastulum, Worick Arcangelo and Nicolas Brown work as the Handymen, taking dirty jobs from both the mafia families and the police. Worick is a smooth talker with a past he rarely discusses, while Nicolas is a deaf swordsman and a Twilight, one of the drug-dependent, superhuman fighters the city both relies on and despises. After a job targeting a pimp, the pair take in Alex Benedetto, a prostitute who was also meant to be killed, and she becomes part of their household as tensions between the city's factions rise. Manglobe adapted Kohske's manga into 12 episodes in 2015. Contains graphic violence, sexual content and drug use.

net-juu-no-susume.summary: Moriko Morioka is thirty and has just quit a job she held for over a decade, choosing a life of happy unemployment. She throws herself into a fantasy online game, playing as a handsome male character named Hayashi, and soon befriends Lily, a sweet healer who becomes her constant companion. Offline, Moriko rarely leaves her apartment, but on a late-night convenience store run she bumps into Yuta Sakurai, a shy office worker a few years younger. Neither realises how closely their real and virtual lives are connected. Signal.MD adapted Rin Kokuyo's webtoon into 10 episodes in late 2017. It is a gentle romantic comedy about adults who are awkward with people.

super-no-ura-de-yani-suu-futari.summary: Sasaki is a tired middle-aged office worker whose only comfort after long days of being scolded at work is buying something from Yamada, a cheerful young cashier at a 24-hour supermarket. One night her shift is over, and as he looks for somewhere to smoke, a sharp-tongued woman called Tayama waves him over to the back of the store. She teases him about his obvious fondness for Yamada, and their late-night cigarette breaks become a regular habit. Their banter is relaxed and occasionally flirtatious, and the story stays small and grounded. Asahi Production adapted Jinushi's manga into 12 episodes from July to September 2026. It is a low-key romantic comedy for adults.

re-creators.summary: Teenager Sota Mizushino dreams of writing his own stories but has stalled. While watching an anime, he is briefly pulled into one of its battles, and when he comes back, its heroine, the knight Selesia Yupitilia, has come with him into modern Tokyo. She is not alone: characters from manga, games, novels and anime keep appearing in the real world, some wanting to confront the people who wrote their suffering, and a mysterious girl in military uniform seems to be behind it. Sota and a growing circle of creators and characters try to stop the conflict. Troyca produced this original 22-episode series in 2017. Contains violence.

sankarea.summary: Chihiro Furuya is a teenage boy obsessed with zombie movies, so much so that he daydreams about having an undead girlfriend. When his cat is killed, he secretly tries to brew a resurrection potion. Along the way he meets Rea Sanka, a sheltered girl from a rich family who comes to an old well to shout out her frustrations with her controlling father. Rea becomes curious about Chihiro's experiment and ends up drinking the potion, and before long she becomes a zombie, which leaves Chihiro looking after her as her body slowly changes. Studio Deen adapted Mitsuru Hattori's manga into 12 episodes in spring 2012. Contains fan service and themes of parental abuse.

hunter-x-hunter.summary: Gon Freecss is a twelve-year-old boy raised by his aunt on remote Whale Island. He has grown up believing his father was dead, until he learns that Ging is alive and a famous Hunter, one of the licensed elite who track down treasure, creatures, criminals and lost places. Determined to find him, Gon leaves home to take the Hunter Exam, a gruelling and often deadly series of trials. Along the way he befriends Killua, a boy from a family of assassins; Kurapika, the last survivor of a slaughtered clan; and Leorio, a brash would-be doctor. Nippon Animation adapted Yoshihiro Togashi's manga into 62 episodes from 1999 to 2001. Contains violence.
hunter-x-hunter.notes: This is the 1999 Nippon Animation series, not the 2011 Madhouse remake.

the-world-god-only-knows.summary: Keima Katsuragi is a high school student who ignores real life entirely in favour of dating sim games, where he is so skilled that online fans call him the God of Conquest. When he answers an email challenge, he ends up bound by contract to Elsie, a cheerful but clumsy demon from Hell. Her job is to catch runaway evil spirits that hide in the empty spaces of girls' hearts, and the only way to drive one out is to make the girl fall in love. Keima, who has no interest in real girls, must now use his game strategies on actual classmates. Manglobe adapted Tamiki Wakaki's manga into 12 episodes in late 2010, followed by two more series.

isekai-ojisan.summary: Takafumi Takaoka's uncle has been in a coma for seventeen years after being hit by a truck. When he suddenly wakes up, he insists he has spent all that time as a hero in a fantasy world called Granbahamal, and he proves it by casting real magic. Takafumi takes his socially awkward uncle in, and the two start a video channel to earn money from his spells. As the uncle shares his memories, the flashbacks show adventures in which he completely missed the feelings of the women around him, and he is far more excited about old Sega consoles than modern life. Atelier Pontdarc adapted Hotondoshindeiru's web manga into 13 episodes between 2022 and 2023.

skip-to-loafer.summary: Mitsumi Iwakura grew up in a tiny seaside town in Ishikawa and has moved to Tokyo to attend a top high school, armed with a detailed life plan that ends with a government career helping rural areas like her own. Her plan wobbles on day one, when she loses her way to the entrance ceremony. She is helped by Sosuke Shima, a good-looking, easygoing classmate, and the pair end up becoming friends. Mitsumi's earnest, unpolished personality slowly draws in a group of classmates with their own insecurities. P.A. Works adapted Misaki Takamatsu's manga into 12 episodes in spring 2023. It is a gentle comedy about friendship and growing up.

drifters-tv.summary: In 1600, during the fighting at Sekigahara, the samurai Toyohisa Shimazu is gravely injured holding off the enemy so his clan can retreat. Instead of dying, he finds himself in a strange white corridor lined with doors, where a silent man at a desk sends him through one of them. He wakes in a world of elves, dwarves and warring kingdoms, alongside other famous figures from history pulled in the same way, including Oda Nobunaga and the archer Nasu no Yoichi. These Drifters soon learn that a rival group of summoned figures, the Ends, wants to wipe out humanity. Hoods Entertainment adapted Kouta Hirano's manga into 12 episodes in 2016. Contains graphic violence.

make-heroine-ga-oosugiru.summary: Kazuhiko Nukumizu is a first-year high school student in Toyohashi who considers himself a background character, content to stay out of other people's stories. Then, at a family restaurant, he overhears his classmate Anna Yanami getting turned down by the childhood friend she has loved for years, and ends up stuck with her bill. Soon he is also crossing paths with other girls who have lost out in love, including the track star Lemon Yakishio and the painfully shy literature club member Chika Komari. Nukumizu becomes their reluctant listener and occasional helper. A-1 Pictures adapted Takibi Amamori's light novels into 12 episodes in summer 2024, with a second season announced.

katanagatari.summary: In a stylised version of Edo-period Japan, Shichika Yasuri is the seventh head of Kyotoryu, a fighting style that uses no sword at all: the fighter's own body is the blade. He and his older sister Nanami live in exile on a remote island until Togame, a sharp-tongued strategist serving the shogunate, arrives with a proposal. She wants Shichika's help to collect the twelve legendary swords forged by the master smith Kiki Shikizaki, each held by a dangerous owner. White Fox adapted Nisio Isin's light novels into 12 hour-long episodes, released one a month through 2010. It is dialogue-heavy, with stylised fights. Contains violence.

rokka-no-yuusha.summary: When the Demon God is about to reawaken, a goddess of fate chooses six heroes and marks each with a flower crest. Adlet Mayer, a cocky fighter who calls himself the strongest man in the world and relies on tricks and gadgets, receives the mark and sets off alongside Nashetania, a princess who is also one of the six. When the chosen heroes finally gather at a temple near the demons' territory, there are seven of them, which means someone is an impostor, and suspicion falls on Adlet. Trapped by a barrier, he must work out who is lying. Passione adapted Ishio Yamagata's light novels into 12 episodes in summer 2015. It plays more as a mystery than an adventure.

is-infinite-stratos.summary: Infinite Stratos units are powered exoskeletons that only women can operate, and they have reshaped the world's balance of power. Then fifteen-year-old Ichika Orimura is found to be the one man able to pilot one, and he is sent to the IS Academy, a training school where every other student is a girl. His strict older sister Chifuyu teaches there, and his childhood friend Houki is a classmate. Soon several girls from around the world, each a skilled pilot, are competing for Ichika's attention while he remains oblivious and tries to keep up in training battles. Eight Bit adapted Izuru Yumizuru's light novels into 12 episodes in early 2011, followed by a second season in 2013. Contains fan service.

laputa-castle-in-the-sky.summary: Sheeta, a young girl wearing a mysterious crystal pendant, is being held aboard an airship by a government agent named Muska when sky pirates attack it. In the confusion she falls from the ship, and her pendant glows and lets her drift gently down to a mining town, where she is caught by Pazu, a young engineer's apprentice. Pazu dreams of finding Laputa, a legendary floating city that his late father once claimed to have seen. Soon the pirates, Muska and the army are all chasing the two children, because the pendant holds the key to Laputa. Hayao Miyazaki wrote and directed this 1986 film, the first produced by Studio Ghibli. It is a family adventure with some action.

otomege-sekai-wa-mob-ni-kibishii-sekai-d.summary: A Japanese man is bullied by his younger sister into clearing an otome game, a romance game aimed at women, and dies in an accident soon after. He is reborn in that game's world as Leon Fou Bartfort, a background character from a poor, minor noble family, in a kingdom where women hold the power and men must work hard to marry. Using what he knows of the game, Leon claims a hidden relic, the powerful ship and AI partner Luxion, and makes a fortune. At the academy he means to stay in the background, but the game's arrogant heroes provoke him. ENGI adapted Yomu Mishima's light novels into 12 episodes in spring 2022, followed by a second season.
otomege-sekai-wa-mob-ni-kibishii-sekai-d.notes: Second-season date left out: Wikipedia and memory disagree on when it aired.

undead-unluck.summary: Fuuko Izumo carries a curse called Unluck: anyone who touches her is struck by sudden misfortune, often deadly. After years of isolation, she has decided to end her life once her favourite romance manga reaches its finale. Then she meets Andy, a reckless man who cannot die however badly he is injured and who is searching for someone able to kill him. Fuuko's curse might be what he needs, and the two form an unlikely partnership. They are soon drawn into conflict with the Union, a secret organisation that tracks people with powers like theirs. David Production adapted Yoshifumi Tozuka's manga into 24 episodes from 2023 to 2024. Contains graphic violence, suicidal themes and sexual humour.

shuumatsu-no-walkure.summary: Every thousand years, the gods of every pantheon meet to decide humanity's future, and this time they vote to wipe people out. Before the decision is final, Brunhilde, eldest of the Valkyries, demands Ragnarok instead: a contest of thirteen one-on-one battles between gods and the greatest humans in history. If humanity wins seven, it survives. Brunhilde's sisters transform into weapons for the human fighters, and the bouts begin with legendary warriors facing deities such as Thor and Zeus, with flashbacks revealing each fighter's past. Graphinica adapted the manga by Shinya Umemura, Takumi Fukui and Azychika into 12 episodes released on Netflix in June 2021. Contains graphic violence.

kanojo-mo-kanojo.summary: Naoya Mukai has finally started dating his childhood friend Saki Saki after confessing to her again and again. Almost immediately, a sweet, earnest girl named Nagisa Minase confesses her own feelings and asks him out. Naoya is too honest to lie and does not want to hurt either girl, so he comes up with an outrageous solution: he asks Saki whether he can date them both. Saki is furious, but Nagisa is determined, and soon the three, later joined by more people, are trying to make a very unusual relationship work. Tezuka Productions adapted Hiroyuki's manga into 12 episodes in summer 2021, followed by a second season in 2023. Contains fan service.

seihantai-na-kimi-to-boku.summary: Miyu Suzuki is a bright, chatty high school girl who is always reading the room and worrying about fitting in. Yusuke Tani, who sits near her, is quiet, blunt and seemingly indifferent to what anyone thinks. Miyu finds herself drawn to exactly that quality, and their small, awkward exchanges slowly bring the two closer. The series follows their relationship as they learn how differently they see things, and it also spends time with their friends and the problems in their lives. Lapin Track adapted Koucha Agasawa's web manga into 12 episodes from January to March 2026, followed by a second season the same year. It is a light, warm romantic comedy.

paranoia-agent.summary: In Musashino, Tokyo, the shy character designer Tsukiko Sagi, creator of a hugely popular pink dog mascot, is struggling to come up with a follow-up when she is attacked one night by a boy on golden inline skates swinging a bent golden bat. The press nicknames him Lil' Slugger. The veteran detective Ikari and his younger partner Maniwa doubt her story, but more attacks follow, and each victim seems to be someone under intense pressure. Each episode turns to a different character and their hidden troubles. Satoshi Kon created and directed this 13-episode Madhouse series in 2004. It is surreal and unsettling, and contains violence, suicide and sexual content.

oreshura.summary: Eita Kido watched his parents' marriage collapse, and he has decided that romance is a waste of time. He plans to spend high school studying hard to become a doctor. Then Masuzu Natsukawa, the most sought-after girl in school, tired of turning down admirers, threatens to expose an embarrassing secret from his past unless he poses as her boyfriend. Eita's fake relationship does not go down well with Chiwa Harusaki, his energetic childhood friend, and things grow even more crowded as other girls with their own agendas enter his life. A-1 Pictures adapted Yuji Yuji's light novels into 13 episodes in early 2013. It is a harem romantic comedy with mild fan service.

accel-world.summary: In a future where nearly everyone wears a device that links their brain to the network, Haruyuki Arita is a short, overweight middle schooler who escapes bullies by playing virtual squash alone. The player who finally beats his scores is Kuroyukihime, the school's admired student council vice president. She gives him Brain Burst, a secret program that speeds up the user's thoughts enormously, and with it entry into a hidden fighting game where players called Burst Linkers duel in an accelerated world. Kuroyukihime has enemies within that game and wants Haruyuki at her side. Sunrise adapted Reki Kawahara's light novels into 24 episodes in 2012. Contains violence.

fate-apocrypha.summary: In this alternate branch of the Fate story, the Holy Grail vanished after an earlier war, and decades later the Yggdmillennia clan in Romania reveals that it holds the Grail and breaks away from the Mage's Association. The conflict turns into an unusually large Holy Grail War: seven Servants, legendary heroes summoned from history and myth, fight for the Black faction and seven for the Red. Because the war is so big, a neutral Servant called Ruler, Joan of Arc, is summoned to oversee it, while a homunculus escapes the castle where he was made. A-1 Pictures adapted Yuichiro Higashide's light novels into 25 episodes in 2017. Contains violence.

tantei-wa-mou-shindeiru.summary: Kimihiko Kimizuka has always attracted trouble. At fourteen, on a flight that gets hijacked, he met Siesta, a brilliant detective who made him her assistant and dragged him around the world on dangerous cases for three years. Now seventeen, he is back in Japan trying to live an ordinary school life, because, as the title says, the detective is already dead. That peace ends when a schoolmate, Nagisa Natsunagi, comes to him wanting to find someone connected to her own heart, and more girls with ties to Siesta follow. ENGI adapted Nigojuu's light novels into 12 episodes in summer 2021, with a second season in late 2026. Contains violence.

chiyu-mahou-no-machigatta-tsukaikata-sen.summary: Usato Ken is an ordinary high school student who is summoned to another world by accident, alongside two star members of his student council who are the real heroes the kingdom wanted. Usato turns out to have a rare talent for healing magic, and before he can settle in he is snatched away by Rose, the fearsome commander of the kingdom's rescue squad. Her idea of training is brutal physical conditioning, since a healer in her unit is expected to sprint across battlefields carrying the wounded. Usato grows tough and determined as war with the demon lord's army approaches. Studio Add and Shin-Ei Animation adapted Kurokata's light novels into 13 episodes in early 2024. Contains violence.

bokutachi-wa-benkyou-ga-dekinai.summary: Nariyuki Yuiga comes from a struggling family and needs a special VIP scholarship to afford university. The school grants it, on one condition: he has to tutor its resident geniuses so they can pass entrance exams in the subjects they are worst at. Fumino Furuhashi is a gifted writer who wants to study science, while Rizu Ogata is a maths prodigy set on the humanities, and soon the sporty Uruka Takemoto, a friend from middle school, needs help too. Juggling lessons with their quirks and growing feelings is harder than any exam. Studio Silver and Arvo Animation adapted Taishi Tsutsui's manga into 13 episodes in spring 2019, followed by a second season. Contains fan service.

shiki-anime.summary: Sotoba is a tiny, isolated village surrounded by forest, where everyone knows everyone. One hot summer, a teenage girl named Megumi Shimizu, who dreams of escaping to the city, falls ill and dies suddenly, not long after a mysterious family moves into a grand Western-style mansion overlooking the village. Soon more villagers sicken in the same strange way, and Toshio Ozaki, the village doctor, struggles to work out whether he is facing an epidemic or something else. Others are drawn in too, from a temple monk who writes novels to Natsuno Yuki, a sullen boy from the city. Daume adapted the manga of Fuyumi Ono's novel into 22 episodes in 2010. Contains horror, gore and violence.

gabriel-dropout.summary: Young angels have to live among humans before they can graduate, so Gabriel White Tenma, the top student in her class, comes to Earth to attend a high school and bring happiness to people. Instead she discovers online games and quickly turns into a lazy shut-in who skips school and stays up all night. Around her are Vignette, a demon who is actually responsible and kind; Satanichia, a demon who dreams of great evil but mostly fails; and Raphiel, an angel with a polite smile and a mischievous streak. Doga Kobo adapted Ukami's manga into 12 episodes in early 2017. It is a light comedy built on its characters' clashing personalities.

brand-new-animal.summary: Beastmen, people who can shift into animal form, have hidden from humans for centuries, and Anima City has been built as a place where they can live freely. Michiru Kagemori was an ordinary human girl until she suddenly turned into a raccoon dog beastman. She heads to Anima City looking for answers and a fresh start, and runs into Shirou Ogami, a stern wolf beastman with unusual strength who watches over the city. Together they get mixed up in the crimes, prejudice and politics that surround beastmen inside and outside its borders. Trigger produced this original 12-episode series in 2020, directed by Yoh Yoshinari, and it premiered on Netflix in Japan. Contains violence.

to-be-hero-x.summary: In this world, superpowers come from public trust. Everyone's trust score appears as a number on their wrist, anyone who gains enough of it can become a hero, and powers rise and fall with public opinion. The most trusted hero of all is known simply as X, and a public ranking tracks the top ten. The series is told in arcs, each focused on a different hero and the pressures, doubts and secrets behind their public image, and each animated in its own visual style. Li Haoling directed this 24-episode Chinese-Japanese co-production by Bilibili and Aniplex, released in 2025. Contains violence.

ore-dake-haireru-kakushi-dungeon.summary: Noir Stalgia is the son of a low-ranking noble family, so other nobles look down on him and the job he was promised falls through. Soon after, an old man grants him a rare skill, and Noir learns of a secret dungeon that only he can enter, guarded by a ghostly sage named Olivia. With his new ability he can create, edit and transfer skills, but he must fuel it with points earned through intimate contact, which becomes a running joke. Noir decides to enroll at an elite academy and grow stronger, with his childhood friend Emma close by. Okuruto Noboru adapted Meguru Seto's light novels into 12 episodes in early 2021. Contains frequent fan service.

platinum-end.summary: Orphaned in an accident and mistreated by the aunt and uncle raising him, Mirai Kakehashi jumps from a rooftop on his middle school graduation day, but an angel named Nasse catches him. She explains that God is retiring in 999 days and has asked thirteen angels to each choose a human candidate to replace him, and Mirai is hers. She gives him wings and arrows that can make people fall in love or kill them. Mirai only wants a happy life, but other candidates are willing to murder to win. Signal.MD adapted Tsugumi Ohba and Takeshi Obata's manga into 24 episodes from 2021 to 2022. Contains suicide and graphic violence.

aharen-san-wa-hakarenai.summary: Raido is a tall high school boy with an intimidating face and a habit of overthinking everything. Next to him in class sits Reina Aharen, a tiny, soft-spoken girl who has trouble judging distance with people, so she tends to keep either far too far away or far too close. After Raido picks up an eraser she drops, she decides to be his friend, and her odd ways of showing it, from silent stares to sudden gifts, keep him guessing. Most episodes are short, deadpan comedy sketches about their days together and the classmates watching them. Felix Film adapted Asato Mizu's manga into 12 episodes in spring 2022, followed by a second season in 2025.

buddy-daddies.summary: Kazuki Kurusu and Rei Suwa are partners who work as contract killers in Tokyo. Kazuki is easygoing and sociable, while Rei is quiet and would rather be playing video games. On Christmas Eve, in the middle of a carefully planned hit at a hotel, they are interrupted by Miri, a girl of four who has come to the city alone to find her father and who decides Kazuki is him. With nowhere else for her to go, the two hitmen take her in and try to balance a dangerous job with meals, bedtimes and nursery school. P.A. Works produced this original 12-episode series in early 2023. It mixes family comedy with violent action.

tamako-market.summary: Tamako Kitashirakawa is a cheerful high school girl whose family runs a mochi shop in the Usagiyama shopping street in Kyoto. One day she comes across Dera Mochimazzi, a plump, talking bird from a faraway southern island, who is on a mission to find a wife for the prince of his homeland. After eating too much of the Kitashirakawa family's mochi, Dera ends up living with them. The series follows Tamako, her friends from the baton club, the shopkeepers who have known her since birth and the rival mochi shop across the street. Kyoto Animation produced this original 12-episode series in 2013, directed by Naoko Yamada, followed by the film Tamako Love Story.

natsume-yuujinchou.summary: Takashi Natsume has been able to see yokai, spirits and monsters, since he was little. Orphaned and moved between relatives who found him strange, he is now living with the kind Fujiwara couple in the countryside. There he finds a notebook, the Book of Friends, that once belonged to his grandmother Reiko and that holds the names of many yokai she beat in contests and bound to her. Yokai begin seeking him out to reclaim their names. With help from a powerful spirit who usually takes the shape of a pudgy cat, Natsume decides to return the names one by one. Brain's Base adapted Yuki Midorikawa's manga into 13 episodes in 2008, the first of several seasons.

look-back.summary: In fourth grade, Fujino draws a four-panel comic strip for her school newspaper and loves the praise it earns her. Then her teacher asks her to give up some of the space to Kyomoto, a girl in the same year who has stopped coming to school and whom Fujino has never met. Kyomoto's drawings turn out to be far more skilled than hers, and the shock drives Fujino to practise obsessively for years. When the two girls finally meet, their shared love of drawing becomes the start of a partnership. Kiyotaka Oshiyama wrote and directed this Studio Durian film, released in June 2024 and based on Tatsuki Fujimoto's one-shot manga. Contains a brief scene of violence.

strike-the-blood.summary: Itogami Island is an artificial island off the coast of Japan where humans live alongside vampires, beast-people and other supernatural beings. High school student Kojou Akatsuki has recently become the Fourth Primogenitor, a legendary and supposedly nonexistent vampire with enormous power, though he would rather live normally. To keep watch on him, the Lion King Agency sends Yukina Himeragi, a serious apprentice sword shaman, with orders to kill him if he becomes a threat. She moves in next door and soon becomes his partner as magical incidents keep hitting the island. Silver Link and Connect adapted Gakuto Mikumo's light novels into 24 episodes from 2013 to 2014. Contains fan service and violence.

school-days.summary: Makoto Ito is a high school student who has a crush on Kotonoha Katsura, a quiet girl from another class who rides the same train as him. Too shy to speak to her, he secretly takes her photo and keeps it as his phone wallpaper, hoping it works as a love charm. His classmate Sekai Saionji notices the picture and offers to help him get closer to Kotonoha. Her plan works, but the more time Makoto spends with both girls, the more tangled their feelings become, and the relationships turn sour. TNK adapted 0verflow's adult visual novel into 12 episodes in 2007. Contains sexual content, infidelity and graphic violence.
school-days.notes: Wikipedia article is the visual novel's; its Anime section confirms TNK and 12 episodes. Ending deliberately not described.

shin-no-nakama-ja-nai-to-yuusha-no-party.summary: Gideon once travelled with the Hero, fighting the demon lord's army alongside his younger sister, the Hero herself. When another companion tells him that his support role no longer pulls its weight, he quietly leaves rather than cause trouble. Taking the name Red, he settles in the remote frontier town of Zoltan and opens a small apothecary, hoping for a peaceful life. Not long after, Rit, a famous adventurer and princess who fought beside him years before, turns up and asks to work and live with him. Their slow romance follows. Wolfsbane and Studio Flad adapted Zappon's light novels into 13 episodes in late 2021, with a second season in 2024. Contains mild fan service.

id-invaded.summary: A special police unit uses a system called Mizuhanome to turn traces of a killer's thoughts, recovered from the scene of the crime, into an enterable world built from that person's subconscious. A detective is sent into these dreamlike, shifting worlds to look for clues, always arriving without his memories and finding the body of a girl named Kaeru, whose death he must explain before he can work out anything else. The unit hunts a series of serial killers while signs point to someone manipulating them all. NAZ produced this original 13-episode series in 2020, with Ei Aoki directing and Otaro Maijo writing. Contains graphic violence, suicide and disturbing imagery.

kemono-jihen.summary: Kohachi Inugami is a Tokyo detective who handles cases involving kemono, supernatural beings that live hidden among people. Called to a country village where animal carcasses keep turning up rotting, he meets a boy the villagers call Dorotabo, who is mistreated and works for the family that runs the local inn. The boy has never known his parents, and he is not entirely human. Inugami offers him a place at his agency in Tokyo, where he joins two other young assistants with monstrous blood and starts searching for answers about his family. Ajia-do adapted Sho Aimoto's manga into 12 episodes in early 2021. Contains violence.

tanaka-kun-wa-itsumo-kedaruge.summary: Tanaka is a high school boy whose main goal in life is to do as little as possible. He naps on desks, benches and stairs and avoids anything that might require effort, especially attention. His tall, kind friend Ohta looks after him, carrying him between classrooms and making sure he eats. Their quiet routine is disturbed by classmates such as Miyano, a small girl who wants Tanaka to teach her how to be a cool, mature adult, and her protective friends. Silver Link adapted Nozomi Uda's web manga into 12 episodes in spring 2016. It is a calm, deadpan slice-of-life comedy.

rosario-vampire.summary: Tsukune Aono fails every high school entrance exam except one, so he ends up at Yokai Academy, a boarding school where monsters learn to live disguised as humans. The rule there is that any human found on campus must be killed, so Tsukune has to keep his secret while classmates show their monstrous sides. On his first day he meets Moka Akashiya, a sweet vampire who loves the taste of his blood; if the rosary she wears is pulled off, a far more powerful and arrogant side of her emerges. More monster girls soon set their sights on him. Gonzo adapted Akihisa Ikeda's manga into 13 episodes in early 2008, followed by a second season. Contains fan service.

chi-chikyuu-no-undou-ni-tsuite.summary: In a European kingdom in the fifteenth century, the Church holds that the Earth is the centre of the universe, and teaching otherwise is heresy punishable by torture and execution. Rafal is a twelve-year-old prodigy who plans to study theology because it is the safest path to success. Then he meets Hubert, a scholar who has been secretly researching the idea that the Earth moves around the Sun, and the beauty of that theory starts to unsettle Rafal's careful plans. The story follows a chain of people across years who risk everything for the same forbidden knowledge. Madhouse adapted Uoto's manga into 25 episodes from 2024 to 2025. Contains torture and graphic violence.

gosick.summary: In 1924, Kazuya Kujo, the third son of a Japanese military officer, is studying at St. Marguerite Academy in Sauville, a small fictional European country. His dark hair and eyes make classmates shun him because of a local ghost story. One day a teacher sends him up the school library's tower, where he meets Victorique de Blois, a tiny, sharp-tongued girl who reads constantly and solves mysteries purely to cure her boredom. Her brother, a police inspector, quietly relies on her deductions. Kazuya keeps getting caught up in crimes, and Victorique keeps solving them. Bones adapted Kazuki Sakuraba's light novels into 24 episodes in 2011. Contains violence and murder.

ping-pong-the-animation.summary: Peco and Smile have been friends since childhood and now play on the same high school table tennis team. Peco is loud, confident and naturally gifted, but he skips practice and expects to win. Smile is quiet and barely shows emotion, and although he is talented, he seems unwilling to beat anyone who wants victory more. As tournaments approach, the two face players from other schools, including a Chinese player exiled to a Japanese school and the formidable captain of a powerhouse team, and each must decide what the sport means to him. Tatsunoko Production adapted Taiyo Matsumoto's manga into 11 episodes in 2014, directed by Masaaki Yuasa, with a rough, expressive art style.

sentouin-hakenshimasu.summary: The Kisaragi Corporation is a secret evil organisation that has nearly conquered Earth and now wants other worlds too. It sends Combat Agent Six, a crude, self-serving veteran grunt, to a distant planet together with Alice, a sarcastic android, to scout it for invasion. There Six ends up working for the Kingdom of Grace, where he is put in charge of a squad of misfits: the ambitious knight Snow, the chimera Rose and Grimm, a priestess who wields curses. Six's methods are underhanded, his manners worse, and his reports back home mostly ask for more evil points. J.C.Staff adapted Natsume Akatsuki's light novels into 12 episodes in spring 2021. Contains crude sexual humour.

sousei-no-onmyouji.summary: Rokuro Enmado once dreamed of being the strongest exorcist, but after a tragedy in his past he has sworn off the work. Then Benio Adashino, a gifted and serious young exorcist, falls into his life and moves into the same house. Exorcists in this world fight Kegare, monsters that cross over from Magano, a twisted realm beneath the human one. Rokuro and Benio clash at first, but the head of the exorcists declares them the Twin Star Exorcists, destined to marry and produce a child who will end the Kegare for good. Neither is pleased. Studio Pierrot adapted Yoshiaki Sukeno's manga into 50 episodes from 2016 to 2017. Contains violence.

gakkou-gurashi.summary: Yuki Takeya is a bubbly high school student who adores the School Living Club, whose members actually live at their school around the clock. With her are the gentle club president Yuri, the athletic Kurumi, who never goes anywhere without a shovel, the younger student Miki, their teacher Megu-nee and the dog Taromaru. Yuki spends her days happily attending class and dreaming up club activities. The club's cheerful surface hides a much darker situation, and the first episode is built around a reveal best experienced without warning. Lerche adapted the manga by Norimitsu Kaiho and Sadoru Chiba into 12 episodes in summer 2015. Contains horror, gore and disturbing themes.
gakkou-gurashi.notes: Deliberately withholds the episode-1 reveal about the setting; the content line signals the horror.

dumbbell-nan-kilo-moteru.summary: Hibiki Sakura is a high school girl who loves to eat, and when her friend points out how much weight she has gained, she decides to join a gym. At the newly opened Silverman Gym, she runs into Akemi Soryuin, her school's polished student council president, who turns out to be passionately devoted to muscles. Guided by Machio, a trainer with an absurd physique, the girls work through squats, push-ups and bench presses, and each episode pauses to explain proper form and real exercise tips. Doga Kobo adapted the web manga by Yabako Sandrovich and MAAM into 12 episodes in summer 2019. It is a comedy with fan service and genuine workout advice.

gaikotsu-kishi-sama-tadaima-isekai-e-ode.summary: A man nods off in the middle of a gaming session and wakes up in a forest inside a world much like it, in the body of his character Arc. Arc wears the game's top-tier holy knight armour and has the abilities to match, but beneath the helmet he is a skeleton, so he keeps his face hidden. Hoping for a quiet life as a wanderer, he soon rescues a noblewoman from bandits and meets Ariane, a dark elf warrior, who asks for his help in freeing elves taken by slave traders. Studio KAI and HORNETS adapted Ennki Hakari's light novels into 12 episodes in spring 2022, followed by a second season. Contains violence and some fan service.

chihayafuru.summary: As a sixth grader, Chihaya Ayase's biggest dream is for her older sister to become a famous model. Then Arata Wataya, a quiet transfer student from Fukui, shows her the competitive form of karuta, a fast card game based on a classic collection of a hundred poems, and she is hooked. Together with her childhood friend Taichi Mashima, they promise to keep playing. Years later, in high school, Chihaya sets out to start a karuta club and aim for the national championship, hoping to meet Arata again across the tatami. Madhouse adapted Yuki Suetsugu's manga into 25 episodes from 2011 to 2012, the first of three seasons. It is a sports drama with romance.

rikei-ga-koi-ni-ochita-no-de-shoumei-shi.summary: Ayame Himuro and Shinya Yukimura are graduate science students at Saitama University who believe everything should be backed by data. When Himuro confesses that she might have feelings for Yukimura, neither of them can say what love actually is or how to tell whether it is real. So they treat it like any other research question, designing experiments, collecting measurements and arguing over definitions, with lab mates dragged in as reluctant test subjects. Their logic keeps running into feelings they can't calculate. Zero-G adapted Alifred Yamamoto's web manga into 12 episodes in early 2020, followed by a second season in 2022. It is a light romantic comedy with nerdy humour.

munou-na-nana.summary: Fifty years ago, monstrous creatures called the Enemies of Humanity appeared, and young people with supernatural powers called Talents began to be gathered on a remote island academy to train for the fight. Nanao Nakajima arrives as a transfer student, cheerful and friendly, and claims she can read minds. Her classmates have powers ranging from fire control to immortality. Nana, however, has her own agenda on the island, and the first episode ends with a reveal that is best left unspoiled. Bridge adapted the manga by Looseboy and Iori Furuya into 13 episodes in late 2020. It is a tense psychological thriller. Contains violence and murder.
munou-na-nana.notes: Deliberately withholds the episode-1 reveal about Nana's real purpose.

hanamonogatari.summary: Set after Koyomi Araragi has graduated, this story is told by Suruga Kanbaru, now in her final year of high school. She hears rumours of a being called the Devil who will solve anyone's problems, and she suspects they may be linked to her own bandaged left arm and the supernatural trouble it once caused. Investigating leads her to Rouka Numachi, an old rival from middle school basketball who now collects other people's troubles. Their meeting forces Kanbaru to face questions about her past and her future. Shaft adapted this part of Nisio Isin's Monogatari light novels as five episodes broadcast together on 16 August 2014. It is mostly dialogue and introspection.
hanamonogatari.notes: Wikipedia source is the Monogatari episode list, which covers the 16 Aug 2014 broadcast.

tondemo-skill-de-isekai-hourou-meshi.summary: Office worker Tsuyoshi Mukouda is pulled into another world by a kingdom performing a hero-summoning ritual, but his only skill seems worthless for fighting. It lets him order groceries and cooking supplies from a Japanese online supermarket. Suspicious of the royals, Mukouda leaves to make his own way, and the meals he cooks on the road quickly draw attention, starting with Fel, a legendary wolf who agrees to become his familiar in exchange for regular helpings. Together they travel, take on adventurer work and eat very well. MAPPA adapted Ren Eguchi's light novel series into 12 episodes in early 2023. The tone is relaxed and food-focused.

problem-children-are-coming-from-another.summary: Izayoi Sakamaki, Asuka Kudou and You Kasukabe are three teenagers with unusual powers who find ordinary life dull. Each receives a letter that drops them, quite literally, from the sky into Little Garden, a world where people with special gifts compete in Gift Games for prizes, land and status. Their guide is Kurousagi, a rabbit-eared girl from a struggling community called No Names, which lost its banner and nearly everything else to a demon lord. The new arrivals agree to help rebuild it, mostly because it sounds like fun. Diomedéa adapted Tarō Tatsunoko's light novels into 10 episodes in 2013, mixing action and comedy.

ajin.summary: For years, people who cannot stay dead, called Ajin, have been treated as a danger to humanity. When one is identified, the government takes them away, and few people know or care what happens next. Kei Nagai is a focused high school student studying to become a doctor, and he has never given Ajin much thought, until a traffic accident that should have killed him shows the world that he is one. Suddenly hunted by the authorities and bounty seekers, Kei runs, while other Ajin with their own plans take an interest in him. Polygon Pictures made this 13-episode CG series from Gamon Sakurai's manga in 2016. Contains graphic violence.

bakuman.summary: Moritaka Mashiro can draw, but after watching his uncle's career as a manga artist, he has settled on a safe, ordinary future. Then classmate Akito Takagi, a top student who wants to write stories, finds his sketchbook and asks him to team up and create manga for a living. Moritaka agrees after making a promise with Miho Azuki, the girl he likes, who dreams of voice acting: if their work gets an anime, she will star in it. The pair set out to break into a major weekly magazine. J.C.Staff adapted the manga by Tsugumi Ohba and Takeshi Obata, the duo behind Death Note, into 25 episodes from 2010 to 2011.

claymore.summary: In a medieval land, shape-shifting demons called yoma hide among people and feed on them. The only reliable defence is the Claymores, silver-eyed women who carry huge swords and are part yoma themselves, hired by a secretive organisation to kill the monsters for a fee. Villagers fear them almost as much as the demons. After a Claymore named Clare saves a boy called Raki, he loses his home and chooses to follow her as she travels from job to job, and her reasons for taking up this life slowly come out. Madhouse adapted Norihiro Yagi's manga into 26 episodes in 2007. Contains frequent bloody violence and gore.

absolute-duo.summary: Some people can draw a weapon out of their own soul, and Kouryou Academy trains these Blazers in pairs, aiming for a legendary state called Absolute Duo. Tooru Kokonoe enrolls determined to grow strong after a personal loss, but on the first day he is forced to fight the student beside him, and instead of a weapon, his soul produces a shield. This oddity catches the eye of Julie Sigtuna, a quiet transfer student from abroad, who soon ends up as his partner and roommate. Eight Bit adapted Takumi Hiiragiboshi's light novels into 12 episodes in 2015. It is a school action series with romance and fan service.

nierautomata-ver-1-1a.summary: Thousands of years in the future, machine lifeforms built by alien invaders have taken over the Earth, and humanity has retreated to the Moon. Its last hope is YoRHa, a force of combat androids. One of them, the reserved soldier 2B, is sent down to the surface with 9S, a talkative scanner model, and as they fight through ruined cities they meet machines and androids that do not behave as expected. A-1 Pictures adapted Square Enix's 2017 action game, with the game's director Yoko Taro co-writing the scripts. The 12-episode first season aired in 2023. Contains violence and dark themes.

tensei-shitara-ken-deshita.summary: A man dies in modern Japan and wakes up in a fantasy world as a sword stuck in the ground. He can still think, talk telepathically, move through the air and absorb skills from monsters he defeats, but he wants someone to wield him. He finds Fran, a young girl of the Black Cat tribe escaping slavery, who frees him from a beast and names him Teacher. She hopes to become the first of her people to evolve into a stronger form, and the two set off as adventurers. C2C adapted Yuu Tanaka's light novel series into 12 episodes in late 2022. Contains fantasy violence and some dark backstory.

world-trigger.summary: Years ago, a gate to other worlds opened over Mikado City, and invaders called Neighbors began pouring through. Ordinary weapons do little to them, so an organisation named Border defends the city using technology called Triggers. Osamu Mikumo is a trainee member with modest talent and a strong sense of duty. When Yuma Kuga, a cheerful and oddly fearless transfer student, joins his class, the two get pulled into a Neighbor attack, and Osamu learns his new classmate is not what he seems. Toei Animation adapted Daisuke Ashihara's manga into 73 episodes from 2014 to 2016. It focuses on team tactics and strategy as much as fights.

new-game.summary: Aoba Suzukaze grew up loving a fantasy game series called Fairies Story. Right after high school, she takes a job as a character designer at Eagle Jump, the studio behind it, and is thrilled to be assigned to the third game, in a team led by Kou Yagami, the artist whose designs inspired her. Her new colleagues in the art team include the shy Hifumi, the cheerful Yun and the figure-loving Hajime, and the series follows her first months at work, from learning 3D modelling to surviving crunch. Doga Kobo adapted Shōtarō Tokunō's four-panel manga into 12 episodes in 2016. It is a gentle workplace comedy.

honzuki-no-gekujou-shisho-ni-naru-tame-n.summary: Urano Motosu adores books and is about to start work as a librarian when an accident ends her life. She wakes in the body of Myne, a sickly five-year-old in a poor family in a medieval-style city, where printing does not exist and books are rare luxuries owned by nobles and churches. Unable to get anything to read, Myne decides to make books herself, starting from scratch with paper, ink and whatever her family and a loyal neighbour boy can help her try. Ajia-do adapted Miya Kazuki's light novels into 14 episodes in 2019. It is a slow-building story about craft, family and social class.

non-non-biyori.summary: Hotaru Ichijou, a fifth-grader from Tokyo, moves with her family to Asahigaoka, a rural village where the bus comes rarely, the nearest shop is far away and the local school has just five pupils in one classroom. Her new classmates include Renge Miyauchi, a first-grader with a unique way of talking, and the Koshigaya siblings: mischievous Natsumi, small Komari and the silent Suguru. Episodes follow their everyday life through the seasons, from catching insects to festivals. Silver Link adapted Atto's manga into 12 episodes in 2013, and later seasons followed. It is a slow, quiet slice-of-life comedy.

shuumatsu-nani-shitemasu-ka-isogashii-de.summary: Five centuries ago, monsters called the Beasts overran the surface and humans died out. The surviving races now live on islands floating in the sky. Willem Kmetsch, a former soldier who wakes from a long sleep as the last human, gets by with odd jobs until he is hired as caretaker of an army warehouse. The weapons stored there turn out to be young girls, leprechauns raised to fight the Beasts with ancient swords, and Willem grows close to them, especially the calm and cheerful Chtholly. Satelight and C2C adapted Akira Kareno's light novels into 12 episodes in 2017. It is a melancholy fantasy romance.

magi-sinbad-no-bouken-tv.summary: Long before the events of Magi: The Labyrinth of Magic, Sinbad is born in a poor fishing village in the Parthevia Empire, the son of a former soldier. As a boy he hears of the dungeons, mysterious towers that have appeared across the world, holding great power and treasure that no one has ever returned with. At fourteen, charming and fearless, he sets out to conquer one, beginning the rise of a legendary adventurer and king. Lay-duce adapted the spin-off manga written by Shinobu Ohtaka and drawn by Yoshifumi Ohtera into 13 episodes in 2016. It works as a standalone prequel. Contains fantasy violence.

guimi-zhi-zhu.summary: Zhou Mingrui, a young man from modern China, wakes up in the body of Klein Moretti, a recent university graduate in a city much like Victorian England, full of steam engines, rival churches and occult dangers hidden from ordinary people. The real Klein's life ended under strange circumstances, and while searching for an explanation and a way home, Zhou is drawn into a hidden world of Beyonders, people with mystical powers, and the churches that keep watch over them. B.CMAY Pictures adapted the Chinese web novel by Cuttlefish That Loves Diving into a 13-episode donghua in 2025. Contains horror imagery and violence.

baka-to-test-to-shoukanjuu.summary: At Fumizuki Academy, students are sorted into classes by their exam scores. Class A gets air conditioning and reclining seats, while Class F, the bottom, sits on rotting mats at broken tables. The school also lets students summon small creatures whose strength depends on test results and fight with them. Akihisa Yoshii, a cheerful but famously dim student, lands in Class F alongside his scheming friend Yuuji Sakamoto and Mizuki Himeji, a brilliant girl who fell ill during her exam, and the class declares war on the others. Silver Link adapted Kenji Inoue's light novels into 13 episodes in 2010. It is a fast-paced comedy.

dagashi-kashi.summary: Kokonotsu Shikada's family has run a small cheap-sweets shop in the countryside for generations, but he wants to draw manga, not inherit the business. One summer, Hotaru Shidare, the eccentric daughter of a major sweets company, arrives to recruit his father. The father agrees on one condition: Hotaru first has to persuade Kokonotsu to run the shop. So she keeps visiting, armed with endless enthusiasm for dagashi, the inexpensive Japanese snacks and candies that each episode explores. Feel adapted Kotoyama's manga into 12 episodes in 2016. It is a light comedy built around snacks, with a little romantic tension.

d-gray-man.summary: In an alternate 19th century, a figure called the Millennium Earl preys on grief: he offers to bring back the dead, then traps their souls inside weapons called Akuma that hunt humans. Only Exorcists, who carry a rare substance called Innocence, can destroy Akuma and free the souls inside. Allen Walker, a polite teenager whose left arm is his weapon and whose cursed eye sees the trapped souls, joins the Black Order to fight the Earl alongside other Exorcists. TMS Entertainment adapted Katsura Hoshino's manga into 103 episodes from 2006 to 2008. Contains violence and dark themes.

initial-d-first-stage.summary: Takumi Fujiwara is a quiet high schooler in Gunma who cares little about cars, even though he has spent years delivering tofu for his father's shop in the family's old Toyota AE86, driving the mountain road on Akina before dawn. When the Akagi Red Suns, a well-known racing team led by the Takahashi brothers, come to challenge the local drivers, one of them is beaten one night by a mysterious AE86. Rumours start, and Takumi is drawn into the world of mountain-pass street racing. Studio Gallop and Studio Comet adapted Shuichi Shigeno's manga into 26 episodes in 1998, the first of several stages.

kishuku-gakkou-no-juliet.summary: Dahlia Academy is a boarding school shared by students from two rival countries: the Black Doggies of Touwa and the White Cats of West. The two houses fight constantly. Romio Inuzuka, the hot-headed leader of the Touwa first-years, has secretly loved Juliet Persia, his counterpart from West, for years, and when he finally confesses, she agrees to date him. From then on, the couple must hide what is going on from both sides while trying to do ordinary couple things. LIDENFILMS adapted Yōsuke Kaneda's manga into 12 episodes in 2018. It is a romantic comedy loosely inspired by Romeo and Juliet.
