ragna-crimson.summary: In this world, dragons from ancient bloodlines prey on humans, and hunters kill them using silver weapons or by exposing them to sunlight. Leonica is a gifted young hunter. Her partner Ragna is considered weak and unlucky, since dragons always seem to come after the people around him, but she trusts him anyway. When Ragna is given power and knowledge from a future version of himself, he sets out to wipe out dragonkind entirely, joining forces with Crimson, a scheming and mysterious ally. Silver Link adapted Daiki Kobayashi's manga into 24 episodes from 2023 to 2024. Contains frequent graphic violence.

mato-seihei-no-slave.summary: Yuuki Wakura is a high schooler unsure of his future when he stumbles into Mato, a parallel world full of monsters called Shuuki. Mato also grows magical peaches that give special powers to women only, so an all-female Demon Defense Force guards the border. Yuuki is rescued by Kyouka Uzen, captain of the force's Seventh Unit, whose power lets her turn a living creature into an obedient servant and borrow its strength. Using it on Yuuki works far better than expected, and she brings him into the Seventh Unit in an unusual role. Seven Arcs adapted the manga by Takahiro and Yohei Takemura into 12 episodes in 2024. Contains strong sexual content and fan service.

eizouken-ni-wa-te-wo-dasu-na.summary: High school first-year Midori Asakusa fills sketchbooks with detailed imaginary worlds but is too shy to make anime on her own. Her friend Sayaka Kanamori is the opposite: tall, blunt and interested mainly in money. When they meet Tsubame Mizusaki, a popular teen model who secretly wants to be an animator, the three found a film club, Eizouken, to make their own anime. The show slips into their daydreams as they plan scenes, and also covers budgets, deadlines and dealing with the student council. Science SARU adapted Sumito Ōwara's manga into 12 episodes in 2020, directed by Masaaki Yuasa.

god-eater.summary: In 2071, much of the world has been devoured by Aragami, monsters made of cells that consume almost anything and shrug off conventional weapons. Humanity survives in fortified enclaves run by the organisation Fenrir, which fields God Eaters, soldiers bonded to living weapons called God Arcs that can wound the Aragami. Lenka Utsugi is a newly recruited God Eater of a rare type whose weapon switches between sword and gun, and he joins a unit fighting in the Far East branch. Ufotable adapted Bandai Namco's action game into 13 episodes, airing from 2015 into 2016 after schedule delays. Contains violence and monster gore.

summer-wars.summary: In 2010, most of daily life runs through OZ, a huge online world where people shop, work and handle official business through avatars. Kenji Koiso, a shy high school maths whiz who does part-time maintenance work on OZ, is asked by older schoolmate Natsuki Shinohara to come to her family's home in Ueda to help celebrate the 90th birthday of her great-grandmother, where she introduces him to her huge family as her fiancé. That night he solves a strange coded message, and the next morning he finds himself blamed for a crisis spreading across OZ. Mamoru Hosoda directed this 2009 Madhouse film, an original story.

kore-wa-zombie-desu-ka.summary: Ayumu Aikawa is a high schooler who was killed by an unknown attacker and brought back as a zombie by Eucliwood Hellscythe, a necromancer in armour who barely speaks because her words have dangerous power. Now he avoids sunlight, feels little pain and is hunting for his killer. One night he runs into Haruna, a loud, chainsaw-wielding magical girl, and accidentally takes her powers, leaving him to fight monsters while wearing her frilly outfit. Soon his house fills up with odd female guests. Studio Deen adapted Shinichi Kimura's light novels into 12 episodes in 2011. It is a gag comedy with action, cartoonish gore and fan service.

koi-to-uso.summary: In this version of Japan, a government programme matches every citizen with a spouse, notified by text when they turn sixteen, and love outside the system is officially discouraged. Yukari Nejima, an ordinary student, decides to confess to his long-time crush Misaki Takasaki before his notice arrives, and she returns his feelings. Then his official match comes through: Ririna Sanada, a reserved girl who is just as unenthusiastic about the arrangement. LIDENFILMS adapted Musawo's manga into 12 episodes in 2017. It is a romantic drama about first love, rules and the choices teenagers are allowed to make.

shijou-saikyou-no-daimaou-murabito-a-ni-.summary: Varvatos was so overwhelmingly strong that the world called him the Demon Lord, and he spent his life feared and lonely. Wanting ordinary friends more than anything, he chooses to be reborn, and three millennia on he grows up as Ard Meteor, a boy from an apparently unremarkable family in a rural village. He has deliberately weakened himself, yet magic has declined so much since his era that he still outclasses everyone, and his awkwardness makes friendship harder than any battle. Meanwhile, the legend he left behind starts causing problems. Silver Link and Blade adapted Myōjin Katō's light novels into 12 episodes in 2022. It is a fantasy action comedy.

senpai-ga-uzai-kouhai-no-hanashi.summary: Futaba Igarashi has been working in sales at a trading company for nearly two years. She is small, earnest and short-tempered, and the person who annoys her most is her mentor, Harumi Takeda, a huge, loud colleague who jokes about her height and talks to her as if she were a kid. He is also dependable, always ready to help when a job goes wrong, and Futaba slowly realises her irritation is turning into something else. Episodes follow office life, after-work drinks and their co-workers' own relationships. Doga Kobo adapted Shiro Manta's manga, which began as an online web comic, into 12 episodes in 2021. It is a light office romantic comedy.

kakkou-no-iinazuke.summary: Nagi Umino is a hard-working student who grew up helping at his parents' family restaurant. Erika Amano is a wealthy influencer with a carefree personality. They meet by chance and then learn they were switched as newborns at the hospital. To bring both children back into their birth families at once, their parents decide that Nagi and Erika should get engaged and live together. Neither of them agrees, and Nagi already likes someone else, but the arrangement goes ahead. Shin-Ei Animation and SynergySP adapted Miki Yoshikawa's manga into 24 episodes in 2022, and a second season followed. It is a romantic comedy.

lazarus.summary: In 2052, a cheap painkiller called Hapna has been used around the world for years without apparent side effects. Then its creator, Dr. Skinner, who vanished soon after its release, reappears with an announcement: the drug will eventually kill everyone who took it, and he will only share a cure if someone finds him before a deadline runs out. A special team named Lazarus is put together to track him down, including Axel, a prisoner with a talent for escaping. Shinichirō Watanabe created and directed this original 13-episode series, produced by MAPPA and broadcast in 2025. Contains violence.

isekai-nonbiri-nouka.summary: Hiraku Machio dies young after a long illness that kept him in a hospital bed. A god offers him a second life in another world and lets him choose what he wants; Hiraku asks for health and a quiet farming life, and receives an all-purpose farming tool that can become any implement he needs. He starts alone in a vast forest, clearing land and growing crops, and over time vampires, elves, beastfolk and other races join his growing village. Zero-G adapted Kinosuke Naito's light novels into 12 episodes in 2023. It is a calm, slow-paced fantasy about building a community.

golden-boy.summary: Kintaro Oe is a 25-year-old drifter who has dropped out of university and now rides his bike around Japan, taking whatever temporary job he can find, from office work to housekeeping. He treats every job as a chance to learn and scribbles notes as he goes, and at each stop he meets a woman who first sees him as a hopeless pervert and later learns there is more to him. Each episode is a standalone story. APPP adapted Tatsuya Egawa's manga into a six-episode OVA released from 1995 to 1996. Contains frequent sexual humour and nudity.

zetsuen-no-tempest.summary: A month after Yoshino Takigawa's best friend Mahiro Fuwa disappears, a strange girl pulls a gun on Yoshino, and Mahiro reappears to rescue him. Mahiro has made a deal with Hakaze Kusaribe, a powerful sorceress who has been marooned on a deserted island by her own clan and can only reach him from afar. She will help him find whoever killed his sister Aika, who was also Yoshino's secret girlfriend, if he helps rescue her. Bones adapted the manga written by Kyō Shirodaira and Arihide Sano and drawn by Ren Saizaki into 24 episodes from 2012 to 2013. Contains violence.

natsu-e-no-tunnel-sayonara-no-deguchi.summary: Kaoru Tono is a high schooler in a small town, quietly struggling after events that have split his family. One night he finds a tunnel that seems to match a local rumour: whoever enters the Urashima Tunnel can get back anything they have lost, but time passes strangely inside. Anzu Hanashiro, a sharp-tongued transfer student with her own wish, learns about the tunnel, and the two agree to investigate it together over the summer. Tomohisa Taguchi directed this 2022 CLAP film, adapted from Mei Hachimoku's light novel. It is a short, quiet drama about grief, ambition and first love.

the-wind-rises.summary: Jiro Horikoshi dreams of building aeroplanes from childhood, and since poor eyesight rules out becoming a pilot, he studies aeronautical engineering instead, guided in dreams by the Italian aircraft designer Giovanni Caproni. The film follows him from the 1920s onward, through the Great Kanto Earthquake, his work at a large engineering firm and his relationship with Naoko Satomi, as Japan moves towards war. It is a fictionalised account of the real engineer who designed Japanese fighter planes. Hayao Miyazaki wrote and directed this 2013 Studio Ghibli film, based on his own manga. It is a slow, adult drama rather than a fantasy adventure.

kimi-to-boku-no-saigo-no-senjou-aruiwa-s.summary: For over a century, the technologically advanced Empire has been at war with the Nebulis Sovereignty, a nation founded by mages who wield a force called astral power. Iska, a young imperial swordsman, was jailed for helping a witch escape, but he is released on the condition that he defeats Aliceliese, a Nebulis princess the Empire fears as the Ice Calamity Witch. When the two finally meet on the battlefield, they find they are well matched and share the same wish to end the war, and an awkward attraction grows. Silver Link adapted Kei Sazane's light novels into 12 episodes in 2020. Contains battle violence.

panty-stocking-with-garterbelt.summary: Panty and Stocking are two angels kicked out of Heaven for bad behaviour and stuck in Daten City, a place midway between Heaven and Hell. To earn their way back, they must collect Heaven coins by destroying ghosts, under the supervision of a priest named Garterbelt. Panty fights with a pistol made from her underwear and mostly cares about sex; Stocking slices ghosts with swords made from her stockings and mostly cares about sweets. Gainax produced this 13-episode original series, directed by Hiroyuki Imaishi, in 2010, drawn in a flat Western-cartoon style. A sequel aired in 2025. Contains explicit sexual humour, crude jokes and violence.

love-live-school-idol-project.summary: Otonokizaka High School in Tokyo is losing students and may close. Second-year Honoka Kosaka refuses to accept that, and after seeing a popular school idol group perform, she decides to start one herself to attract new applicants. Two friends she has known since childhood, Umi Sonoda and Kotori Minami, join her, but the student council president Eri Ayase is openly against the idea, and the new group, μ's, needs more members, songs and an audience. Sunrise produced this 13-episode first season in 2013 as part of the Love Live! franchise conceived by Hajime Yatate and Sakurako Kimino. It mixes music performances with school comedy and drama.

kinsou-no-vermeil-gakeppuchi-majutshi-wa.summary: Alto Goldfilled is a diligent pupil of the Ortigia Academy of Magic who is about to be held back a year because he cannot summon a familiar. In desperation, he tries a spell from an old, worn grimoire and calls up Vermeil, a powerful and playful demon who had been sealed away. Grateful to be free, she agrees to serve him and seals the contract with a kiss, and the pair become far stronger than anyone at school expects, attracting dangerous attention. Staple Entertainment adapted the manga written by Kōta Amana and drawn by Yōko Umezu into 12 episodes in 2022. Contains fan service.

bokutachi-no-remake.summary: Kyouya Hashiba is 28 and out of work after a failed attempt to break into game development, and he has moved back in with his parents. He envies the so-called Platinum Generation, celebrated creators of his own age, and regrets choosing an ordinary university over studying art. Then he wakes up ten years earlier, just as he is about to start college, and this time enrols at an arts university. He moves into a shared house with three fellow students who will one day be among those celebrated creators. Feel adapted Nachi Kio's light novels into 12 episodes in 2021. It is a drama about creative work and second chances.

azumanga-daioh.summary: Over three years of high school, a group of girls in the same homeroom go through classes, sports festivals, exams and summer trips together. There is Chiyo, a ten-year-old prodigy who skipped several grades; Tomo, loud and hyperactive; her short-tempered friend Yomi; Sakaki, tall and quiet, who secretly loves cute animals; and Osaka, a transfer student whose mind wanders in strange directions. Their teacher Yukari is arguably less mature than any of them. J.C.Staff adapted Kiyohiko Azuma's four-panel manga into 26 episodes in 2002, made up of short comic sketches. It is a gentle, absurd school comedy with no real overarching plot.

eden-of-the-east.summary: In late 2010, several missiles strike empty parts of Japan without hurting anyone, and the public quickly forgets the incident, nicknamed Careless Monday. Three months later, college graduate Saki Morimi is on a trip to Washington, D.C., when she gets into trouble outside the White House and is helped by a young man who is completely naked, has lost his memory and is holding a pistol and a phone. The phone carries billions of yen in digital money and a direct line to a mysterious concierge. Kenji Kamiyama created and directed this 11-episode original series for Production I.G in 2009, with character designs by Chica Umino. It is a political mystery thriller.

shirobako.summary: In high school, five friends in an animation club made a short film together and promised to work on a real anime one day. A few years later, Aoi Miyamori is a production assistant at Musashino Animation, a mid-sized studio trying to finish a TV series on time, and the show follows her days of chasing late artwork, booking voice actors, smoothing over arguments and driving cuts across Tokyo, while her friends try to break into the industry in their own ways. P.A. Works produced this original 24-episode series, directed by Tsutomu Mizushima, from 2014 to 2015. It is a detailed workplace drama about how anime is made.

tensai-ouji-no-akaji-kokka-saisei-jutsu-.summary: With his father the king ill, Prince Wein Salema Arbalest becomes regent of Natra, a small, cold and poor northern kingdom. Everyone believes he is a brilliant leader. Privately, he would like nothing more than to sell the country to a bigger power and retire in comfort, and he plans to raise Natra's value first so the deal is worth more. Each scheme he tries, with the help of his loyal aide and closest friend, somehow succeeds far beyond what he wanted, leaving him even more trapped in the job. Yokohama Animation Laboratory adapted Toru Toba's light novels into 12 episodes in 2022. It is a political comedy with light strategy.

assassins-pride.summary: Humanity's last cities sit under glass domes in the land of Flandore, protected from monsters outside by nobles whose blood gives them mana. Melida Angel, a noble girl, has never shown any mana and is mocked at her elite academy. Kufa Vampir is sent to be her tutor, but his real job is to find out whether her bloodline is legitimate and to kill her quietly if it is not. Instead, impressed by her determination, he decides to protect her and find a way to awaken her power. EMT Squared adapted Kei Amagi's light novels into 12 episodes in 2019. It is a school fantasy action series with some fan service.

kimi-wa-houkago-insomnia.summary: Ganta Nakami barely sleeps, and his tiredness has made him prickly and isolated at school. When he goes looking for a quiet place to rest, he finds the school's abandoned observatory already occupied by Isaki Magari, a cheerful, popular classmate who turns out to have insomnia too. The two start sharing the space, and to keep using it, they revive the defunct astronomy club and begin taking night photos of the stars. Their late nights help both of them more than either expected. LIDENFILMS adapted Makoto Ojiro's manga into 13 episodes in 2023. It is a calm, low-key romance about loneliness and friendship.

maoyu.summary: Humans and demons have been at war for fifteen years. A hero leaves his companions behind and storms the Demon King's castle alone, only to find that its ruler is a demon queen, a scholar who wants to talk, not fight. She points out that the war is propping up economies and holding alliances together on both sides, and that simply winning it would cause new disasters. She asks him to join her in changing the world through farming techniques, education and trade instead of swords. Arms adapted Mamare Touno's light novels into 12 episodes in 2013. It is a slow-paced fantasy about economics and politics, with some romance.

bakemono-no-ko.summary: Nine-year-old Ren has run away and is living rough in Shibuya, angry and alone after losing his mother. In a back alley he meets Kumatetsu, a powerful but crude bear-like warrior from a hidden city of beasts, who is looking for an apprentice. Kumatetsu needs a disciple to compete for the title of the beasts' next lord, so Ren follows him into the other world and is renamed Kyuta. The two argue constantly as teacher and student, yet slowly learn from each other. Mamoru Hosoda wrote and directed this 2015 film for Studio Chizu. It is a coming-of-age adventure with fantasy action.

araburu-kisetsu-no-otome-domo-yo.summary: Five girls in their high school's literature club spend their afternoons reading classic novels aloud, including the racy parts. When one of them answers a question about what she wants to do before she dies with the word sex, the topic takes over their thoughts. Kazusa Onodera, the most innocent of them, is already confused about her childhood friend Izumi, and an embarrassing accident makes things worse, while the others face their own awkward discoveries about attraction. Lay-duce adapted the manga written by Mari Okada and drawn by Nao Emoto into 12 episodes in 2019. Contains frank discussion of sexuality and some sexual situations.

yuusha-yamemasu.summary: Leo Demonheart is the hero who drove back the Demon Queen Echidna's invasion almost single-handedly. His power was so overwhelming that the people he saved began to fear him, and he was driven out of the kingdom. With nowhere else to go, he shows up at the demons' castle and applies for a job in Echidna's army. Taking on a new identity, he sets about training her badly beaten forces into a stronger fighting force, though he has his own reasons for doing so. EMT Squared adapted the light novels by Quantum into 12 episodes in 2022. It is a fantasy comedy with action.

kara-no-kyoukai-1-fukan-fuukei.summary: In the late 1990s, a string of teenage girls have fallen to their deaths from the same abandoned high-rise, and the police treat them as unrelated suicides. Shiki Ryougi, a cold, kimono-wearing young woman whose eyes can see the lines of death in things, works for Touko Aozaki, a mage who runs a small agency dealing with supernatural cases, alongside Shiki's devoted friend Mikiya Kokutou. When the case touches Mikiya, Shiki goes to the building herself. This 2007 ufotable film is the first of the Garden of Sinners films adapted from Kinoko Nasu's novels. Contains disturbing imagery and themes of suicide.

seitokai-yakuindomo.summary: Takatoshi Tsuda enrols at Ousai Academy, a former girls' school that has only just started admitting boys. On his very first morning, student council president Shino Amakusa stops him, and since the council wants a boy's perspective, he is drafted on the spot as its vice president. Shino looks like a model student but cannot stop making dirty jokes, the secretary Aria is a wealthy girl who is even worse, and the treasurer Suzu, the sane one, is sensitive about her small size. Takatoshi spends every day reacting to their antics. GoHands adapted Tozen Ujiie's four-panel manga into 13 episodes in 2010. Contains near-constant sexual jokes.

whisper-of-the-heart.summary: Shizuku Tsukishima is fourteen, loves books and spends her summer holiday reading instead of studying for her high school entrance exams. She notices that the same name, Seiji Amasawa, appears on the borrowing cards of many of her library books, and wonders who he is. Following a cat she meets on a train leads her to an antique shop and a cat figurine called the Baron, and to a boy who already has clear plans for his future. Seeing that pushes Shizuku to test her own talent for writing. Yoshifumi Kondō directed this 1995 Studio Ghibli film, written by Hayao Miyazaki and based on Aoi Hiiragi's manga.

romantic-killer.summary: High schooler Anzu Hoshino is happiest with three things: video games, chocolate and her cat. Romance does not interest her at all. Then a tiny wizard named Riri appears from her game console, announces that she has been chosen for a project to boost the country's birth rate, and takes away all three. From then on, Riri keeps setting up classic dating-sim scenes with attractive boys, starting with Tsukasa Kazuki, a handsome boy at her school, and Anzu fights back against every one of them. Domerica adapted Wataru Momose's web manga into 12 episodes released in 2022. It is a parody of romantic comedy clichés.

keijo.summary: Keijo is a hugely popular professional sport in which women stand on floating platforms in a pool and try to knock each other into the water, using only their chests and backsides. After finishing school, Nozomi Kaminashi, a cheerful former gymnast from a poor family, enrols at a keijo training school hoping to win prize money. There she makes friends and rivals and learns over-the-top special moves, as training escalates into tournaments between schools. Xebec adapted Daichi Sorayomi's manga into 12 episodes in 2016. It is played as an earnest sports anime despite its premise. Contains constant fan service focused on the athletes' bodies.

sewayaki-kitsune-no-senko-san.summary: Kuroto Nakano is an overworked office employee who lives alone and comes home exhausted every night. One evening he finds Senko, an 800-year-old fox spirit who looks like a small girl with fluffy ears and a tail, waiting in his apartment. Sent by the gods to ease his stress, she has decided to look after him: cooking his meals, cleaning his flat and letting him relax by stroking her tail. The series follows their quiet daily life, with occasional visits from other fox spirits and a nosy neighbour. Doga Kobo adapted Rimukoro's web manga into 12 episodes in 2019. It is a gentle, comforting comedy.

mamahaha-no-tsurego-ga-moto-kano-datta.summary: Mizuto Irido and Yume Ayai went out together in middle school, then broke up right after graduation. Before high school begins, Mizuto's father remarries, and the woman he marries turns out to be Yume's mother, making the two former lovers stepsiblings under the same roof. Unwilling to tell anyone the truth, they agree to a rule: whoever acts like they still see the other as more than a sibling loses and must accept being the younger one. Project No.9 adapted Kyōsuke Kamishiro's light novels into 12 episodes in 2022. It is a romantic comedy mixed with flashbacks to their past relationship.

saihate-no-paladin.summary: A man who wasted his previous life is reborn as a baby named Will in a ruined city, where three undead take him in and bring him up: Blood, a boisterous skeleton warrior; Mary, a gentle mummy priestess; and Gus, a grumpy ghost sorcerer. They teach him swordsmanship, faith and magic, and he grows up loved and determined to live this life properly. As he nears adulthood, he starts to wonder why three undead are living in a dead city and what will happen when he has to leave. Children's Playground Entertainment adapted Kanata Yanagino's light novels into 12 episodes from 2021 to 2022. It is a fantasy coming-of-age story.

the-secret-world-of-arrietty.summary: Sho, a sickly twelve-year-old boy, is sent to rest at his great-aunt's old house in the suburbs of Tokyo before an operation. Living secretly beneath the floor are the Borrowers, people only a few centimetres tall who survive by taking small things humans will not miss. Arrietty, a curious fourteen-year-old Borrower, is spotted by Sho on her first borrowing trip with her father Pod, which puts her family in danger. Hiromasa Yonebayashi directed this 2010 Studio Ghibli film in his debut, with a screenplay by Hayao Miyazaki and Keiko Niwa based on Mary Norton's 1952 novel The Borrowers. It is a gentle, small-scale family drama.

shikanoko-nokonoko-koshitantan.summary: Torako Koshi is the model student at her high school: graceful, top of her class and student council president. Nobody there knows that in middle school she was a flashy delinquent, and she intends to keep it that way. Then she meets Noko Shikanoko, a transfer student who has antlers, acts like a deer and seems to know all about Torako's past. To keep her secret buried, Torako ends up dragged into Noko's schemes, including a newly founded Deer Club. Wit Studio adapted Oshioshio's manga into 12 episodes in 2024. It is a loud, absurd comedy full of deer jokes and surreal gags.

nausicaa-of-the-valley-of-the-wind.summary: Ten centuries after industrial civilisation destroyed itself in war, a poisonous forest called the Sea of Corruption is spreading across the land, filled with deadly spores and giant insects. Nausicaä, daughter of the ruler of a small seaside farming kingdom called the Valley of the Wind, lives where ocean winds keep the spores away. She glides on the wind, studies the forest instead of fearing it and can calm the huge insects. When an airship from the powerful kingdom of Tolmekia crashes in the valley, her people are drawn into a war over an ancient weapon. Hayao Miyazaki wrote and directed this 1984 Topcraft film, based on his own manga. Contains some battle violence.

beelzebub.summary: Ishiyama High is a school run entirely by delinquents, and its most feared student is first-year Tatsumi Oga, a brawler with a terrifying grin. One day by the river, Oga pulls a floating man out of the water, and the man splits open to reveal a baby. The infant clings to Oga at once: he is Baby Beel, son of the Demon Lord, sent to the human world to be raised, and his demon maid Hilda tells Oga he is now the parent. If Oga strays far, the baby unleashes a massive electric shock, so he is stuck. The TV adaptation of Ryuhei Tamura's manga ran for 60 episodes from 2011 to 2012. It is a silly action comedy.

pluto.summary: In a world where robots live alongside humans and are given legal rights, someone is killing the most advanced robots on the planet, as well as humans who championed robot rights. Gesicht, a robot detective working for Europol, takes the case and notices that the victims have one thing in common, and that he may be on the list too. The investigation leads him to the other great robots of the world, including Atom, a robot boy in Japan. Studio M2 adapted Naoki Urasawa's manga, a reworking of an Astro Boy story by Osamu Tezuka, into eight long episodes released in 2023. It is a slow, serious mystery. Contains violence and themes of war.

tensei-shitara-dai-nana-ouji-dattanode-k.summary: A commoner sorcerer who loved magic but never had the talent to master it dies and wakes up as a baby, Lloyd, seventh in line among the princes of Saloum. Now he has royal blood, a huge reserve of mana and no realistic chance of inheriting the throne, which suits him perfectly, since it leaves him free to research spells all day. Lloyd tries to keep a low profile, but his experiments keep drawing him into trouble, from monsters to freed demons, and he settles each problem with cheerful ease. Tsumugi Akita Animation Lab adapted Kenkyo na Circle's light novels into 12 episodes in 2024. It is a light fantasy action series.

inou-battle-wa-nichijou-kei-no-naka-de.summary: One day, the members of a high school literature club suddenly gain supernatural powers. Jurai Andou, who never grew out of his love of edgy fantasy names and poses, is thrilled, but his ability, a black flame, turns out to be completely useless. The girls get far more impressive gifts: Tomoyo can control time, his childhood friend Hatoko commands the elements, club president Sayumi can restore anything to its original state, and young Chifuyu can create things from nothing. Instead of fighting evil, they mostly carry on with ordinary club life. Trigger adapted Kōta Nozomi's light novels into 12 episodes in 2014. It is a comedy with some romance.

kakushigoto-tv.summary: Kakushi Goto draws a moderately successful manga full of crude gags. He is also a devoted single father to his ten-year-old daughter Hime, and he is terrified that she will be ashamed of him if she ever learns how he actually earns money. So every morning he leaves home in a suit as if heading to an office, changes clothes before reaching his studio, and goes to absurd lengths, with help from his long-suffering assistants, to keep her from learning the truth. Ajia-do adapted Kōji Kumeta's manga into 12 episodes in 2020. It is mostly a comedy about the manga business, with a gentle and sometimes bittersweet family story.

class-de-2-banme-ni-kawaii-onnanoko-to-t.summary: Maki Maehara is a high school student who mostly keeps to himself and spends his free time on video games and low-budget films. Umi Asanagi is part of the most popular group in class; the boys rank her second only to her best friend Yuu Amami. One day they discover they share the same hobbies, and Umi starts coming over to Maki's place every Friday to play games, watch movies and eat junk food, while acting like near strangers at school. Their secret friendship slowly becomes something more. Connect adapted the light novels by Takata into 12 episodes in 2026. It is a low-key romantic comedy.

bishoujo-senshi-sailor-moon.summary: Usagi Tsukino is a fourteen-year-old schoolgirl in Tokyo who sleeps late, fails tests and cries easily. After rescuing a black cat with a crescent mark on its forehead, she learns that the cat, Luna, can talk and has been searching for her: Usagi is Sailor Moon, a warrior destined to fight the Dark Kingdom, whose servants are stealing people's energy for Queen Beryl. As the fights continue, other girls awaken as Sailor Guardians, and she keeps running into a masked ally, Tuxedo Mask. Toei Animation adapted Naoko Takeuchi's manga, and this first season of 46 episodes aired from 1992 to 1993, directed by Junichi Sato.

watashi-ga-motete-dousunda.summary: Kae Serinuma is a kind-hearted, overweight high schooler and a passionate otaku who loves imagining boys falling in love with each other. When her favourite anime character dies, she locks herself in her room for a week, too upset to eat, and comes out dramatically thinner. Suddenly four boys from school, including classmates and an upperclassman, are competing for her attention, and later a girl joins in too. Kae would much rather pair them up with one another than date any of them. Brain's Base adapted Junko's manga into 12 episodes in 2016. It is a reverse-harem romantic comedy that pokes fun at fan culture.

kanata-no-astra.summary: In 2063, travel between planets is routine, and a group of high school students heads off on a short camping trip to a nearby planet. Soon after landing, a mysterious glowing sphere swallows them and throws them out into deep space, thousands of light-years from home. They find an empty spaceship nearby, but its supplies will not last the trip back, so they must plot a route through unknown planets, gathering food and water as they go. Led by sporty Kanata Hoshijima and cheerful Aries Spring, they begin to suspect someone wanted them gone. Lerche adapted Kenta Shinohara's manga into 12 episodes in 2019. It is a science fiction survival mystery.

kono-oto-tomare.summary: Takezou Kurata is the only remaining member of his high school's koto club, and he must recruit new players before the club is shut down. The first to apply is Chika Kudou, a delinquent with a bad reputation whose late grandfather made kotos, the traditional Japanese stringed instrument. Next comes Satowa Houzuki, a prickly prodigy from a famous koto family, and a few of Chika's friends. None of them get along at first, but they set their sights on a national competition. Platinum Vision adapted Amyu's manga into 13 episodes in 2019, with a second cour later that year. It is a music drama about friendship and growing up.

ssss-gridman.summary: Yuta Hibiki wakes up in his classmate Rikka Takarada's house with no memory of who he is. A voice calls him from an old computer, where a hero calling itself Hyper Agent Gridman appears on the screen and tells him he has a mission. Soon a giant monster attacks the town, and Yuta merges with Gridman to fight it. Oddly, the next day the damage is gone and no one remembers the attack. With Rikka and his friend Sho Utsumi, Yuta starts to look into what is really going on. Trigger and Tsuburaya Productions made this 12-episode series in 2018, based on the 1993 tokusatsu show Denkou Choujin Gridman. Contains monster battles and mild violence.

lv2-kara-cheat-datta-moto-yuusha-kouho-n.summary: Banaza, a merchant, is summoned along with others to the kingdom of Klyrode to become a hero who will fight the Dark Army. His stats are so poor that the kingdom quickly writes him off and sends him to a remote forest. Then he levels up to level 2 and finds that his abilities have become nearly limitless. Instead of seeking revenge or glory, he changes his name to Flio and settles into a quiet life, sharing his home with Rys, a wolf demi-human girl he meets there who soon falls for him. J.C.Staff adapted Miya Kinojo's light novels into 12 episodes in 2024. It is a gentle fantasy with domestic comedy and light action.

paripi-koumei.summary: Zhuge Liang, also known as Kongming, the great strategist of China's Three Kingdoms era, dies on campaign wishing for a peaceful life. He wakes up young again in present-day Shibuya, in the middle of Halloween night, and ends up at a club, where he hears Eiko Tsukimi, an aspiring singer struggling to be noticed. Moved by her voice, he offers to become her strategist and applies ancient military tactics to her music career, from booking gigs to winning over audiences and rival performers. P.A. Works adapted the manga written by Yuto Yotsuba and drawn by Ryo Ogawa into 12 episodes in 2022. It is a music comedy with plenty of heart.

kimi-to-nami-ni-noretara.summary: Hinako Mukaimizu has moved to a seaside town for university and spends most of her time surfing, without any plan for her future. When a fire breaks out in her apartment building, she is rescued by Minato Hinageshi, a young firefighter who is skilled at his job and eager to help everyone. They get to know each other, she teaches him to surf, and the two fall in love. Then something happens that shakes her life, and she has to find a way to keep moving forward. Masaaki Yuasa directed this original 2019 film for Science SARU. It is a romantic drama with a fantasy element.

aldnoah-zero.summary: In this alternate history, humans who settled Mars found ancient technology called Aldnoah and founded the Vers Empire, which went to war with Earth. A disaster on the Moon in 1999 ended the fighting, and an uneasy truce has held for fifteen years. In 2014, Princess Asseylum of Vers visits Earth on a goodwill trip, but an attack on her motorcade gives the Martian knights the pretext for a new invasion. High schooler Inaho Kaizuka, calm and analytical, is drawn into the fighting in a training-grade machine. A-1 Pictures and Troyca produced this original 12-episode series in 2014, and a second part followed in 2015. Contains war violence.

cardcaptor-sakura.summary: Ten-year-old Sakura Kinomoto lives in the town of Tomoeda with her father and older brother. One day she finds a strange book in the basement and accidentally scatters the magical Clow Cards inside it across town. The book's guardian, a small winged creature called Kero, explains that the cards are dangerous on the loose and that she must capture them all. With help from her best friend Tomoyo, who designs her outfits and films her adventures, and competition from a rival card hunter, Sakura sets out. Madhouse adapted CLAMP's manga into 70 episodes from 1998 to 2000. It is a gentle magical girl series.

imouto-sae-ireba-ii.summary: Itsuki Hashima is a young light novelist whose books are all about little sisters. He lives with Chihiro, his capable stepbrother who cooks and keeps house for him, and he is surrounded by fellow writers: Nayuta Kani, a brilliant new novelist who is openly in love with him; his friend Miyako Shirakawa, who is not in the industry; and Haruto Fuwa, a more successful author. They meet to play board games, drink and swap stories about deadlines, editors and adaptations. Silver Link adapted Yomi Hirasaka's light novels into 12 episodes in 2017. It is a comedy about the publishing business. Contains sexual humour and nudity.

no-6.summary: After a great war, people live in a few walled city-states, and No. 6 is presented as a perfect, peaceful utopia. Shion is a gifted boy from its elite class. On his twelfth birthday he shelters a wounded runaway named Nezumi, and as a result he and his mother lose their privileges. Four years later, Shion is working an ordinary job when a strange outbreak begins in the city, and he is accused of a crime. Nezumi returns to rescue him, taking him to the poor district outside the walls, where Shion sees what the city hides. Bones adapted Atsuko Asano's novels into 11 episodes in 2011. Contains violence and disturbing imagery.

gakuen-babysitters.summary: High schooler Ryuuichi Kashima and his toddler brother Kotarou are left on their own when an air crash takes both their parents. At the funeral, Youko Morinomiya, the strict chairwoman of a prestigious academy, offers to take them in and pay for Ryuuichi's schooling. Her condition is that he works for the school's babysitting club, a daycare room for the young children of the academy's teachers, which badly needs help. So between classes, Ryuuichi looks after Kotarou and a handful of lively, very different toddlers. Brain's Base adapted Hari Tokeino's manga into 12 episodes in 2018. It is a warm, gentle comedy about family and childcare.

boushoku-no-berserk.summary: In this world, everyone is born with a skill that decides their place in life. Fate Graphite's skill, Gluttony, seems to do nothing except leave him constantly starving, so he works as a despised gatekeeper and is bullied by the holy knights who rule the city. Then he kills a fleeing criminal and discovers what Gluttony really does: it consumes the abilities and stats of those he kills, while making him hungry for more. Roxy Hart, the one kind holy knight he knows, offers him a job, and Fate begins to grow stronger in secret. A.C.G.T. adapted Ichika Isshiki's light novels into 12 episodes in 2023. Contains violence.

demi-chan-wa-kataritai.summary: Demi-humans, people with traits from folklore creatures, live openly in modern Japan, though they are still rare. Tetsuo Takahashi, a high school biology teacher, has always wanted to study them, and this year his school has three Demi students: Hikari Takanashi, a cheerful vampire; Kyouko Machi, a polite dullahan whose head is separate from her body; and Yuki Kusakabe, a shy snow woman. There is also a new maths teacher, Sakie Satou, a succubus who has to avoid affecting people around her. Takahashi listens to them and helps with their everyday problems. A-1 Pictures adapted Petos's manga into 12 episodes in 2017. It is a gentle school comedy.

mayo-chiki.summary: Growing up with a mother and older sister who practised wrestling holds on him has made Kinjirou Sakamachi physically tough but terrified of women: if one touches him, he gets a nosebleed and may pass out. One day in the boys' bathroom, he stumbles on the secret of Subaru Konoe, the school's most admired butler, who serves the headmaster's daughter Kanade Suzutsuki: Subaru is a girl. To keep his mouth shut, the two girls offer a deal, and Kanade decides to help cure his phobia in her own sadistic way. Feel adapted Hajime Asano's light novels into 13 episodes in 2011. Contains fan service and slapstick violence.

carole-and-tuesday.summary: Fifty years after humans began settling Mars, most popular music is produced with the help of AI. Carole is a street-smart young woman in Alba City who works part-time jobs and plays keyboard whenever she can. Tuesday is a shy girl from a rich family who has run away from home with nothing but her guitar. They meet by chance on a bridge, play together, and decide to become a duo, writing their own songs and trying to be heard in an industry that rarely leaves room for newcomers. Bones produced this original 24-episode series, created by Shinichirō Watanabe, in 2019. It is a music drama with comedy and some political themes.

cider-no-you-ni-kotoba-ga-wakiagaru.summary: Cherry is a quiet teenager who rarely says what he feels, preferring to write haiku that he posts online with almost no reaction. He is spending his last summer in a country town working part-time at a day-care centre for the elderly before his family moves. Smile is a cheerful online video streamer who hides her braces behind a face mask. They meet by accident at a shopping mall, and soon they are both helping an elderly man named Fujiyama search for a lost vinyl record that matters deeply to him. Kyōhei Ishiguro directed this original 2021 film for Signal.MD and Sublimation. It is a bright, gentle summer romance.

isekai-cheat-magician.summary: Taichi Nishimura and Rin Azuma, friends since childhood, are walking to school when a flash of light transports them to a fantasy world. After a group of adventurers saves them from a monster, they are sent to the local guild to register, and an aptitude test reveals that both have enormous magical talent: Taichi can use all four elements, while Rin specialises in summoning powerful spirits. With no way home, they take on adventurer work and try to understand the world and their unusual gifts. Encourage Films adapted Takeru Uchida's light novels into 12 episodes in 2019. It is a straightforward fantasy adventure with action.

tokyo-ravens.summary: Long ago, the legendary onmyoji Yakou Tsuchimikado caused a magical catastrophe that still troubles Tokyo, and a government agency now deals with the spiritual disasters it left behind. Harutora Tsuchimikado belongs to a branch of the same family but cannot even see spiritual energy, so he plans an ordinary life. As children, though, he promised to serve as the familiar of his cousin Natsume, heir of the main family and rumoured to be Yakou reborn. When an attack puts Natsume in danger, Harutora keeps his word and follows her to a school for onmyoji. 8bit adapted Kōhei Azano's light novels into 24 episodes from 2013 to 2014. Contains violence.

shadows-house.summary: In a huge mansion on a remote cliff live the Shadows, a noble family with no faces, whose bodies are pitch black and give off soot when they feel strong emotion. Each young Shadow is paired with a Living Doll, a servant who looks human and acts as their face, showing expressions for them. Emilico is a cheerful, newly assigned Doll who serves Kate, a calm and thoughtful Shadow girl. As she cleans soot, learns the strict rules of the house and meets other Dolls, Emilico starts to notice that much about the house is being kept from her. CloverWorks adapted Somato's manga into 13 episodes in 2021. It is a gothic mystery with some eerie moments.

happy-sugar-life.summary: Satou Matsuzaka is a popular high school girl who has dated many people but never felt real love until she meets Shio Koube, a small child. Satou takes Shio into her apartment, tells everyone she lives with an aunt, and dedicates her life to keeping what she calls their sweet, happy life together. Anyone who threatens it, from classmates to co-workers to people searching for Shio, becomes a problem she is willing to deal with by any means. Ezóla adapted Tomiyaki Kagisora's manga into 12 episodes in 2018. It is a psychological horror story. Contains violence, abuse, sexual themes and deeply disturbing content.

b-the-beginning.summary: On the island nation of Cremona, a masked killer known as Killer B is murdering criminals, and the Royal Investigation Service cannot catch him. The agency brings back Keith Flick, a brilliant, eccentric investigator who has been sidelined in the archives after a painful past case, to work alongside Lily Hoshina, an energetic young rookie. Meanwhile, Koku, a young man with strange powers and missing memories, is searching for someone of his own, and the killings start to look connected to something larger. Production I.G produced this original 12-episode series, created by Kazuto Nakazawa, released on Netflix in 2018. Contains graphic violence.

witch-watch.summary: Morihito Otogi is a high schooler descended from ogres, a line that began when witches of old wed familiars in human shape. He looks normal but has tremendous strength. His childhood friend Nico Wakatsuki, a cheerful witch, returns from years of magical training determined to make him her familiar, and with both of his parents away, the two end up living in the same house. Morihito has also been asked to guard Nico from a disaster predicted for her future, while she quietly hopes he will notice her feelings. Bibury Animation Studios adapted Kenta Shinohara's manga into 25 episodes in 2025. It is a supernatural comedy with romance and action.

ichiban-ushiro-no-daimaou.summary: Akuto Sai enrols at Constant Magic Academy hoping to become a high-ranking sorcerer and use his position to do good in the world. On the way he befriends Junko Hattori, an earnest, justice-minded girl from a ninja family. At the entrance ceremony, though, an aptitude prophecy announces that his future profession is Demon King. The school panics, Junko decides she must keep him in line, and every well-meant thing Akuto does seems to confirm his terrifying reputation, while a growing number of girls attach themselves to him. Artland adapted Shōtarō Mizuki's light novels into 12 episodes in 2010. It is a fantasy comedy. Contains fan service.

haibane-renmei.summary: A girl dreams that she is falling through the sky, then hatches from a large cocoon in an abandoned building. She has no memory of her past, and soon she grows small grey wings and receives a halo. The other residents call her Rakka, after her dream, and explain that she is a Haibane, one of a group of winged beings living in a walled town where nobody may leave or touch the wall. Rakka settles into her new life with her kind housemates, especially the older, protective Reki. Radix produced this 13-episode series in 2002, based on Yoshitoshi ABe's self-published manga. It is a quiet, melancholy drama.

saikyou-onmyouji-no-isekai-tenseiki-gebo.summary: Haruyoshi Kuga was the greatest exorcist of his time in old Japan, but jealous rivals had him killed. As he died, he used a spell to be reborn and vowed to be more careful in his next life. He wakes in a fantasy world as Seika Lamprogue, born out of wedlock into a noble family of mages that looks down on him for appearing to have no magic. Seika still commands his old powers and a large number of yokai servants, and he tries to keep his strength hidden while making allies and enrolling at a magic academy. Studio Blanc adapted Kiichi Kosuzu's light novels into 13 episodes in 2023. Contains fantasy violence.

bunny-drop.summary: Daikichi Kawachi is a thirty-year-old bachelor who goes back to his family home for his grandfather's funeral. There he meets Rin, a quiet six-year-old girl who turns out to be his grandfather's secret daughter. None of the relatives want to take responsibility for her, and they talk about her as a burden while she listens. Angered, Daikichi announces that he will raise her himself, despite having no idea how to care for a child. The series follows the pair as he learns to balance work and parenting and she settles into her new home. Production I.G adapted Yumi Unita's manga into 11 episodes in 2011. It is a warm family drama.

one-hundred-man-no-inochi-no-ue-ni-ore-w.summary: Yusuke Yotsuya is a cynical student who prefers video games to people. One day he and two classmates, the popular athlete Iu Shindo and the frail Kusue Hakozaki, are suddenly pulled into a fantasy world that works like a role-playing game. A mysterious voice gives them quests with time limits, and failing a quest means something terrible. Yotsuya treats the whole thing like a game to be beaten, which often clashes with his teammates' sense of right and wrong. Maho Film adapted the manga written by Naoki Yamakawa and drawn by Akinari Nao into 12 episodes in 2020. Contains violence.

deca-dence.summary: Long ago, giant creatures called Gadoll nearly wiped out humanity. The survivors now live in Deca-Dence, a massive moving fortress about three kilometres tall. Gears are the warriors who fight the Gadoll, while Tankers like Natsume, a determined girl with a prosthetic arm, are expected to work in support. Natsume wants to fight, but her application is rejected, so she is assigned to an armour repair crew led by Kaburagi, a grumpy man who clearly has secrets of his own. He sees something in her that might change the world. Yuzuru Tachikawa directed this original 12-episode series for NUT in 2020. Contains violence.

vampire-knight.summary: Cross Academy has two separate student bodies. The Day Class attends lessons in daylight, and the glamorous Night Class takes over at dusk. The Day Class does not know that every Night Class student is a vampire. Yuki Cross, the headmaster's adopted daughter, and her moody childhood friend Zero Kiryu serve as guardians who keep the two groups apart and protect the secret. Yuki owes her life to Kaname Kuran, the pureblood vampire who leads the Night Class, who rescued her as a child, while Zero hates vampires. Studio Deen adapted Matsuri Hino's manga into 13 episodes in 2008. It is a gothic romance with some blood and violence.

little-witch-academia.summary: When she was little, Atsuko 'Akko' Kagari saw a magic show by the famous witch Shiny Chariot and decided to become a witch herself. Now she is a student at Luna Nova Magical Academy, but she comes from a non-magical family, struggles with flying and spells, and her fellow students mock her idol as childish. Along with her friends Lotte and Sucy, Akko gets a chance to prove herself when a class trip into a dungeon goes wrong. Yoh Yoshinari directed this Trigger short film, released in 2013 as part of the Anime Mirai young animator training project. It was followed by a second film and a TV series. It is an energetic, family-friendly fantasy.

blood-c.summary: Saya Kisaragi seems like an ordinary, slightly clumsy high school girl in a quiet, isolated country town. She helps at the Shinto shrine run by her father Tadayoshi, goes to class with her friends and often stops by the café of her neighbour Fumito. At night, though, she takes up a sacred sword and hunts the Elder Bairns, monsters that devour humans, to keep the town safe. Some of the creatures speak, and they accuse her of breaking a promise she cannot recall. Production I.G made this 12-episode original series with the manga group CLAMP, airing in summer 2011. Contains extremely graphic violence and gore.

kawaikereba-hentai-demo-suki-ni-natte-ku.summary: Keiki Kiryu is a regular high school boy who would love a girlfriend, so he is thrilled to find a love letter in his bag. It is unsigned, though, and it arrives with a pair of girls' underwear. Keen to learn who the sender is, whom he nicknames Cinderella, Keiki starts looking into the girls around him: calligraphy club president Sayuki Tokihara, younger library helper Yuika Koga and his close friend Mao Nanjo. Each one turns out to have a secret fetish she is eager to share. Geek Toys adapted Tomo Hanama's light novels into 12 episodes in summer 2019. Contains frequent sexual humour and fan service.

ookami-shoujo-to-kuro-ouji.summary: Erika Shinohara badly wants to fit in with her new high school friends, who all have boyfriends, so she makes one up. When they ask for proof, she secretly photographs a handsome boy on the street, only for the girls to recognise him as Kyoya Sata, a popular student at their own school known for being kind. Erika begs Kyoya to play along. He agrees, but his sweet image is an act: in private he is cold and mocking, and his price is that she obey him like a pet dog. TYO Animations adapted Ayuko Hatta's shojo manga into 12 episodes, aired from October to December 2014.

dead-mount-death-play.summary: In a world of swords and sorcery, a feared necromancer called the Corpse God is on the verge of being slain by a hero. At the last moment he casts a spell that throws his soul into another world, and he wakes in modern Shinjuku inside the body of Polka Shinoyama, a boy whose throat has just been cut by a killer. Hoping for the quiet life he never had before, he takes over Polka's identity, but Tokyo's criminal underworld and its hidden supernatural factions soon notice him. Geek Toys adapted the manga by Ryohgo Narita and Shinta Fujimoto; this first part ran 12 episodes in spring 2023, and a second part followed. Contains graphic violence.

fruits-basket.summary: Tohru Honda is a cheerful high school girl who has recently lost her mother. Rather than burden her friends while her grandfather's house is renovated, she quietly moves into a tent in the woods. The tent happens to sit on land owned by the Sohma family, and when a landslide flattens it, her classmate Yuki Sohma and his older cousin Shigure, a novelist, offer her a room. Tohru soon finds out the family's secret: some Sohmas turn into zodiac animals whenever a member of the opposite sex hugs them. Studio Deen adapted Natsuki Takaya's manga into 26 episodes, aired from July to December 2001, with Akitaro Daichi directing.

iroduku-sekai-no-ashita-kara.summary: In 2078, teenage Hitomi Tsukishiro comes from a family of witches, but she has lost the ability to see colour and has grown closed off and withdrawn. Her grandmother Kohaku, a powerful witch, decides to help by casting a spell that sends Hitomi sixty years into the past, to 2018, when Kohaku herself was a high school student. Hitomi arrives unexpectedly in the bedroom of Yuito Aoi, a quiet boy who draws, and to her astonishment his pictures appear to her in full colour. She enrols at the local school and gets to know the young Kohaku and her friends. P.A. Works produced this 13-episode original series, directed by Toshiya Shinohara, from October to December 2018.

saijaku-muhai-no-bahamut.summary: Five years after a revolt toppled the Arcadia Empire, its former prince Lux lives modestly, taking odd jobs to get by. One such errand leads him by accident into a girls' bathhouse, where he sees Lisesharte Atismata, princess of the new kingdom, without her clothes. Furious, she challenges him to a duel using Drag-Rides, ancient armoured machines dug up from ruins. Lux is famous as an unbeaten pilot who never attacks anyone, and the fight ends with him enrolled at an academy for female Drag-Knights. Lerche adapted Senri Akatsuki's light novels into 12 episodes in early 2016. Contains frequent fan service and nudity.

busou-shoujo-machiavellianism.summary: Fudo Nomura has been thrown out of his last school after a huge fight, so he transfers to Aichi Symbiosis Academy, a former girls' school that recently went co-ed. There, the girls carry weapons and keep the boys under strict control, and any boy who wants to stay must wear a girls' uniform and behave like one. The rules are enforced by the Supreme Five Swords, a group of skilled fighters led by the stern Rin Onigawara. When Rin orders Fudo to obey, he refuses and fights back, putting himself on a collision course with all five. SILVER LINK. adapted the manga by Yuya Kurokami and Karuna Kanzaki into 12 episodes in spring 2017.

mikakunin-de-shinkoukei.summary: Kobeni Yonomori is an ordinary high schooler who is good at housework and wants a quiet life. On her sixteenth birthday she learns that her late grandfather arranged a marriage for her years ago, and her fiancé, a quiet boy named Hakuya Mitsumine, is moving in along with his small and very protective younger sister Mashiro. Kobeni's own older sister Benio, who adores her a little too much, is not pleased. As the new household settles in, Kobeni begins to notice that Hakuya and Mashiro are not quite ordinary. Doga Kobo adapted Cherry Arai's four-panel comedy manga into 12 episodes, aired from January to March 2014. It is a gentle romantic comedy.

shikkakumon-no-saikyou-kenja.summary: In this world, every mage is born with one of four crests, and the crest sets the limits of their magic for life. A legendary sage, frustrated that his crest left him unsuited to fighting, uses his power to be reborn thousands of years in the future. He returns as Mathias Hildesheimr, a young son of a noble house, now holding the crest he always wanted. But magic has badly declined in this era, basic techniques are forgotten, and his crest is looked down on as the weakest. When he reaches twelve, Mathias enters a royal academy and quickly overturns expectations. J.C.Staff adapted Shinkoshoto's light novels into 12 episodes in early 2022.

yesterday-wo-utatte.summary: Rikuo Uozumi has finished university but has no idea what to do with his life, so he drifts along with a job at a Tokyo convenience store. Haru Nonaka, a free-spirited young woman, keeps showing up at the store and makes no secret of liking him. Rikuo, however, still has feelings for Shinako Morinome, a friend from university who has returned to town as a teacher, while Shinako herself is held back by a painful loss in her past. The three of them circle one another as they try to work out how to move forward. Doga Kobo adapted Kei Toume's manga into 12 episodes in spring 2020, a slow, quiet romantic drama.

mekaku-city-actors.summary: Shintaro Kisaragi has not left his room in two years, and his only company is Ene, a cheeky digital girl living in his computer. On a hot August day he spills a drink over his keyboard, and because nearly every shop is shut for the holiday, he has to go to a department store in person. While he is there, armed men take the shoppers hostage. Shintaro ends up meeting the Mekakushi Dan, a small group of young people with strange powers tied to their eyes. Shaft adapted Jin's Kagerou Project, a story first told through Vocaloid songs, into 12 episodes in spring 2014, with Akiyuki Shinbo as chief director.

gyakkyou-burai-kaiji-ultimate-survivor.summary: Kaiji Ito is an unemployed young man in Tokyo who spends his days drinking, gambling small sums and nursing grudges. Then a loan shark named Endo turns up with bad news: Kaiji co-signed a loan for a former co-worker, who has vanished, and the huge debt is now his. Endo offers a way out, a single night of gambling aboard a ship called the Espoir, where winners can wipe out what they owe and losers face far worse. Kaiji agrees, and finds himself in tense games of strategy, bluffing and betrayal. Madhouse adapted Nobuyuki Fukumoto's manga into 26 episodes from 2007 to 2008. Contains psychological cruelty and some violence.

kuro-no-shoukanshi.summary: A man wakes up in another world with no memory of who he used to be. He learns that before arriving he traded those memories for strong abilities and the role of a summoner. His name is now Kelvin, and his first summoned companion is Melfina, the goddess who handled his reincarnation and whom he picked out of everyone available. Kelvin registers as an adventurer and sets out to build his strength and gather more allies, and it soon becomes clear that he is a battle-lover who gets excited whenever a strong enemy appears. Satelight adapted Doufu Mayoi's light novels into 12 episodes in summer 2022. Contains some fan service.

silent-witch-chinmoku-no-majo-no-kakushi.summary: Monica Everett is one of the Seven Sages, the most powerful mages in the Kingdom of Ridill, and the only person able to cast spells without speaking an incantation. The reason is less heroic than it sounds: she is so painfully shy that she invented silent casting to avoid talking, and she would rather hide away in a cabin in the mountains doing calculations. A fellow sage drags her out with a secret assignment to enrol at Serendia Academy, a school for nobles, and quietly protect Felix Arc Ridill, the second prince. Studio Gokumi adapted Matsuri Isora's light novels into 13 episodes between July and October 2025.

full-metal-panic.summary: Sousuke Sagara is a teenage sergeant in Mithril, a secret private military force that fights terrorism using cutting-edge technology. His new assignment is to guard Kaname Chidori, a hot-tempered Tokyo high school girl whom several shadowy groups want to capture for reasons she does not understand. Backed up from a distance by fellow soldiers Kurz Weber and Melissa Mao, Sousuke enrols in Kaname's class, but having grown up on battlefields, he treats every ordinary school situation as a combat threat. Gonzo adapted Shoji Gatoh's light novels into 24 episodes in 2002, mixing school comedy with military action. Contains violence.

somali-to-mori-no-kamisama.summary: In a world ruled by spirits, goblins and other creatures, humans were nearly wiped out after a war and are now hunted, even eaten. A golem who serves as a guardian of the forest, a quiet giant who keeps strictly to his duties, comes upon a small human girl alone in the woods. She decides he is her father, and he lets her stay with him. Keeping her a secret from the creatures around them, the two set off on a journey to find other humans, with the golem acting as a careful, if awkward, parent. Satelight and Hornets adapted Yako Gureishi's web manga into 12 episodes, aired from January to March 2020.

kokoro-ga-sakebitagatterunda.summary: When Jun Naruse was a small girl who loved fairy tales, she innocently let slip something about her father that broke up her parents' marriage, and he blamed her for it. Soon afterwards she came to believe a fairy egg had sealed her mouth so her words could never hurt anyone again, and since then she has barely spoken, as trying to talk gives her painful stomach cramps. Now in high school, Jun is picked by her teacher, along with three classmates who have little in common, to organise a community event, and the group decides to stage a musical. A-1 Pictures released this original film, directed by Tatsuyuki Nagai, in September 2015.

kaze-ga-tsuyoku-fuiteiru.summary: Kakeru Kurahara was once a standout runner in high school, but he has left the sport behind. While being chased for stealing food from a shop, he catches the eye of Haiji Kiyose, a fellow student at Kansei University who also runs. Haiji offers Kakeru a cheap room at Chikusei-so, a rundown boarding house, and only later reveals his plan: the ten residents will form a team and compete in the Hakone Ekiden, Japan's famous university relay race. The problem is that most of them have never run seriously at all. Production I.G adapted Shion Miura's 2006 novel into 23 episodes running from autumn 2018 into spring 2019.

saikyou-no-ousama-nidome-no-jinsei-wa-na.summary: King Grey was the most powerful ruler in his world, yet for all his power his life lacked any real purpose. After a sudden death, he is reborn as a baby in a new world of magic, keeping all of his old memories. Now named Arthur Leywin, he grows up as the son of two loving parents on the continent of Dicathen, and his talent for magic shows up remarkably early. This time he wants to do things differently and live sincerely for the people he cares about. Studio A-CAT adapted the story by TurtleMe, which began as a web novel, into 12 episodes in spring 2025, and a second season followed.

3d-kanojo-real-girl.summary: Hikari Tsutsui is a high school otaku who prefers anime girls to real ones and is mocked by most of his classmates. His only friend is Yuto Ito, a fellow gamer who likes to wear cat ears. One day Tsutsui is late and gets sent to clean the school pool, where he is paired with Iroha Igarashi, a beautiful girl with a bad reputation for playing around with boys. To his astonishment, she asks him to go out with her. Suspicious and inexperienced, Tsutsui reluctantly agrees to try, and has to learn how a real relationship works. Hoods Entertainment adapted Mao Nanami's manga into 12 episodes in spring 2018; a second season followed.

hazure-waku-no-joutai-ijou-skill-de-saik.summary: Touka Mimori is a quiet high school student who is summoned to a fantasy world along with his whole class to serve as heroes. Most of his classmates receive impressive ranks and skills, but Touka is rated E-rank, and his abilities only cause status effects such as poison and paralysis, which are thought to be useless. The goddess Vicius decides he is dead weight and sends him to a deadly ruin from which nobody returns, while most of the class simply watches. Touka soon realises his skills are far stronger than anyone believed, and he swears revenge. Seven Arcs adapted Kaoru Shinozaki's light novels into 12 episodes in summer 2024. Contains violence.

princess-connect-redive.summary: A young man named Yuuki drops out of the sky onto the continent of Astraea with no memories except his own name, and he can barely look after himself. A kind elf girl called Kokkoro finds him and announces that she is his guide. While doing simple guild jobs to earn money, the pair team up with Pecorine, a bubbly swordswoman with a huge appetite, and Karyl, a prickly girl with cat ears who has her own reasons for joining them. Together they form the Gourmet Guild and go looking for food and adventure. CygamesPictures adapted Cygames' mobile role-playing game into 13 episodes in spring 2020, with Takaomi Kanasaki directing; a second season followed.

hello-world.summary: In a near-future Kyoto, a huge project is recording every detail of the city into a powerful quantum computer. Naomi Katagaki is a shy, indecisive high school boy who loves books and struggles to make choices. One day a three-legged crow steals his library book, and while chasing it he meets a mysterious man whom no one else can see. The stranger says he is Naomi himself, ten years older, and that he has come back to change something that is about to happen to Ruri Ichigyo, a reserved classmate Naomi has barely spoken to. Graphinica produced this science fiction film, directed by Tomohiko Ito, released in Japan in September 2019.

mizu-zokusei-no-mahou-tsukai.summary: After dying in an accident, Ryo Mihara is reborn in the fantasy world of Phi with a talent for water magic. All he really wants is a slow, peaceful life, but he wakes up alone in a remote forest full of dangerous monsters, so he spends his days honing his spells and getting by on his own. Unknown to him, he has also been given a rare trait that stops him from ageing. One day he rescues Abel, an adventurer washed up after a shipwreck, and agrees to escort him back to Lune, where Ryo signs up as an adventurer. Typhoon Graphics and WonderLand adapted Tadashi Kubo's light novels into 12 episodes in summer 2025.

giji-harem.summary: Eiji Kitahama is a high school boy in the drama club whose biggest dream is to be popular with girls. Rin Nanakura, his junior in the club and a gifted actress, offers to make that dream come true in her own way. She plays an entire harem by herself, switching on the spot between personalities, from a playful tease to a calm, composed type and many more. Eiji enjoys every performance, but he does not notice that the girl behind all the roles genuinely likes him. Each episode is a light, short-sketch romantic comedy. Nomad adapted Yu Saito's manga into 12 episodes in summer 2024.

koi-wa-ameagari-no-you-ni.summary: Akira Tachibana is a quiet, guarded high school girl who was once a star sprinter on the track team until a serious foot injury stopped her running. She now has a part-time job at a family restaurant, where she finds herself falling for the manager, Masami Kondo, a forty-five-year-old divorced father who is mild, a little clumsy and often treated as a pushover by his staff. Akira tells him how she feels, and Kondo, startled and unsure how to answer, has to work out how to respond without hurting her. Wit Studio adapted Jun Mayuzuki's manga into 12 episodes, aired from January to March 2018. It deals with a romance across a large age gap.

kubo-san-wa-mob-wo-yurusanai.summary: Junta Shiraishi is so quiet and plain that almost nobody notices him, not even his teachers when they take attendance, as if he were a background extra in his own life. There is even a rumour that seeing him brings good luck. The exception is Nagisa Kubo, the cheerful girl who sits next to him in class. She always spots him, likes to tease him, and keeps pulling him into small situations that make him stand out, which leaves him flustered every time. The series is a gentle, low-key romantic comedy about everyday school life. PINE JAM adapted Nene Yukimori's manga into 12 episodes, broadcast during 2023.

katekyo-hitman-reborn.summary: Tsunayoshi "Tsuna" Sawada is a middle schooler who is bad at sports, bad at studying and too timid to talk to his crush, Kyoko Sasagawa, so his classmates call him Dame-Tsuna, roughly 'Loser Tsuna'. His life changes when a baby in a suit arrives at his house and introduces himself as Reborn, a hitman sent from Italy. It turns out Tsuna is the only remaining heir of the Vongola, a powerful mafia family, and Reborn has come to train him as its next boss, using extreme and often explosive methods. Artland adapted Akira Amano's manga into 203 episodes from 2006 to 2010, moving from comedy into action.

tatoeba-last-dungeon-mae-no-mura-no-shou.summary: Lloyd Belladonna grew up in a village right next to the Last Dungeon, the most dangerous place in the world, where even ordinary farmers casually kill monsters that would terrify an army. Compared with his neighbours, Lloyd has always seemed the weakest, so he leaves home to chase his dream of joining the army in the city. What he does not realise is that, by normal standards, he is astonishingly strong, fast and skilled at magic. He keeps treating great feats as nothing special, which causes plenty of confusion and draws several admiring girls. LIDENFILMS adapted Toshio Sato's light novels into 12 episodes in early 2021.

shakugan-no-shana.summary: Yuji Sakai is an ordinary high school boy until the day the world around him freezes and strange creatures begin feeding on the people nearby. He learns that beings from a parallel world, the Crimson Denizens, secretly consume humans' life force, leaving behind fading copies called Torches that soon vanish and are forgotten. Yuji is saved by a fierce girl with blazing red hair and eyes, a Flame Haze warrior who hunts Denizens, and she tells him that he is no longer quite human himself. He names her Shana, and she starts guarding him while living in his town. J.C.Staff adapted Yashichiro Takahashi's light novels into 24 episodes in 2005 and 2006. Contains fantasy violence.

koori-zokusei-danshi-to-cool-na-douryou-.summary: Himuro is a kind, shy office worker descended from the yuki-onna, the snow women of Japanese folklore. Whenever he gets nervous, flustered or excited, he cannot help freezing things around him, which can mean sudden blizzards at his desk. On his first day at a new company, Fuyutsuki, a calm and level-headed colleague, helps him out of one of these icy situations, and the two begin working side by side. She takes his chilly quirks in her stride with practical fixes, while Himuro quietly falls for her, which only makes the snow worse. Zero-G and Liber adapted Miyuki Tonogaya's web manga into 12 episodes in early 2023. It is a gentle office romantic comedy.

kids-on-the-slope.summary: In the summer of 1966, Kaoru Nishimi, a reserved, studious boy who plays classical piano, moves to a port town in Kyushu to live with relatives. Because his family has moved so often, he has never kept a friend and expects his new school to be no different. Then he runs into Sentaro Kawabuchi, a big, rough delinquent whom the other students fear, and who turns out to be passionate about jazz. Through Sentaro and their classmate Ritsuko Mukae, whose family runs a record shop with a basement for jam sessions, Kaoru starts to learn jazz and finds real friendship. Shinichiro Watanabe directed this 12-episode adaptation of Yuki Kodama's manga for Tezuka Productions and MAPPA in 2012.

kamisama-ni-natta-hi.summary: It is the summer before his university entrance exams, and Yota Narukami should be studying. Instead, he is approached by Hina Sato, a small, odd girl who calls herself the god Odin and announces that the world will end in thirty days. Yota laughs it off, but Hina keeps making predictions, about sports matches and other events, that come true exactly. She moves into his house and starts tagging along everywhere, and with her help Yota sets out to solve the problems of the people around him while the countdown runs. P.A. Works produced this 12-episode original series, written by Jun Maeda of the visual novel brand Key, from October to December 2020.

kino-no-tabi-the-beautiful-world.summary: Kino is a young traveller who rides through the world with Hermes, a talking motorcycle. Their world is made up of many separate countries, each with its own peculiar customs, laws and ways of thinking, and Kino follows one rule: stay in any country for three days and no longer. In each episode the pair arrive somewhere new and observe what they find, some places kind or strange, others unsettling or cruel, without trying to fix or judge them. The tone is calm, thoughtful and often melancholy. A.C.G.T. adapted Keiichi Sigsawa's light novels into 13 episodes in 2003, directed by Ryutaro Nakamura. Contains occasional violence and disturbing themes.

isekai-shikkaku.summary: A gloomy, famous writer known only as Sensei has tired of life and is about to drown himself with his lover, Sacchan, when a truck hits him and sends him to a fantasy world. Annette, the elf priestess who summoned him, expects a hero who will defeat the demon king. Sensei has no interest in heroics and wants only to die properly. After he accidentally rescues a cat-eared fighter whom he names Tama, it occurs to him that Sacchan may have landed in this world too, so he sets off to find her, with Tama and Annette following. Atelier Pontdarc adapted Hiroshi Noda and Takahiro Wakamatsu's manga into 12 episodes in summer 2024. It treats suicide as dark comedy.

space-dandy.summary: Dandy is a laid-back alien hunter with a towering pompadour who roams space looking for rare, undiscovered aliens to register for cash, which he usually spends at his favourite restaurant, BooBies. He flies the ship Aloha Oe with two companions: QT, a cleaning robot, and Meow, a lazy cat-like alien. Most episodes are self-contained and wildly different in style and genre, and the crew often meet strange fates that are forgotten by the next episode. Meanwhile, a scientist named Dr. Gel, working for the Gogol Empire, is trying to capture Dandy for reasons Dandy has no idea about. Bones produced this 13-episode original comedy, with Shinichiro Watanabe as chief director, in early 2014; a second season followed.

the-hentai-prince-and-the-stony-cat.summary: Youto Yokodera is a high school boy with an honest pervert's mind, but whenever he tries to say what he thinks, his words come out sounding polite and noble. Hearing that a stone cat statue grants wishes by taking away unwanted traits, he asks it to remove his false front. At the shrine he meets Tsukiko Tsutsukakushi, a small girl who asks to lose her habit of showing emotions on her face. Both wishes come true, but the traits do not simply disappear: they are passed on to someone else, and the consequences quickly pile up. J.C.Staff adapted Sou Sagara's light novels into 12 episodes in spring 2013. Contains frequent sexual humour and fan service.

inu-x-boku-ss.summary: Ririchiyo Shirakiin is the fifteen-year-old daughter of a wealthy, important family. She wants to stand on her own, but she is sharp-tongued and awkward and says hurtful things she does not mean. Hoping for a fresh start, she moves into Maison de Ayakashi, a heavily guarded apartment building where every resident is given a personal bodyguard, called a Secret Service agent. Ririchiyo insists she does not need one, but she is assigned the extremely devoted Soushi Miketsukami anyway. She also discovers that, like her, the other residents are descended from yokai, spirits of Japanese folklore. David Production adapted Cocoa Fujiwara's manga into 12 episodes in early 2012.

ao-ashi.summary: Ashito Aoi is a third-year junior high student in a small town in Ehime who plays football with raw instinct and wild confidence. After he loses his temper during an important match and is sent off, his team is knocked out. Tatsuya Fukuda, the coach of Tokyo Esperion's youth team, saw something special in his play and invites him to try out in Tokyo. Ashito heads to the city, where he meets highly trained young players and finds out how much about football he does not yet understand. Production I.G adapted Yugo Kobayashi's manga into 24 episodes, aired from April to September 2022, focusing on tactics and training; a second season followed.

heaven-s-lost-property.summary: Tomoki Sakurai is a lecherous teenage boy whose only goal is to live in peace and quiet, though he keeps dreaming of an angel. His eccentric senior Eishiro Sugata is obsessed with a mysterious object he calls the New World, and one night he invites Tomoki to watch the sky with him. Instead, a winged girl named Ikaros falls from the heavens, declares herself an Angeloid and calls Tomoki her master. She is ready to obey his every order, and Tomoki's quiet life is over.
