His childhood friend Sohara, armed with a fierce karate chop, keeps him in check. AIC ASTA adapted Suu Minazuki's manga into 13 episodes in 2009. Contains heavy fan service and sexual humour.

tasogare-otome-x-amnesia.summary: Seikyou Private Academy is an old, sprawling school full of ghost stories. Teiichi Niiya, a first-year student, discovers that one of them is real: Yuko Kanoe, a cheerful, affectionate ghost who died in the school building sixty years ago and remembers nothing about how. Teiichi can see and touch her, and together they form a Paranormal Investigations Club to look into the school's famous Seven Mysteries in the hope of uncovering her past. They are joined by Kirie, Yuko's sharp-tongued relative, and Momoe Okonogi, a cheerful girl who cannot see Yuko at all. Silver Link adapted Maybe's manga into 12 episodes in spring 2012. Contains fan service and some disturbing scenes.

Mononoke-Karakasa.summary: This film takes the mysterious Medicine Seller of the 2007 TV series Mononoke into the Ooku, the Inner Chambers of the shogun's castle in Edo, where women serve under strict rules and fierce rivalries. Two young women, Asa and Kame, arrive there on the same day to begin working and quickly become friends, promising to support each other. When strange incidents disrupt preparations for an important ceremony, the Medicine Seller turns up at the gates, sensing that a mononoke, a vengeful spirit born of human emotion, is at work. Kenji Nakamura wrote and directed this film for EOTA, released in Japan in July 2024; a sequel film followed. Contains frightening and disturbing imagery.

renai-boukun.summary: Guri is a pushy, cosplay-loving girl who claims to be a cupid. She owns the Kiss Note, a notebook that makes any two people whose names are written in it fall for each other once they kiss. By mistake she writes the name of Seiji Aino, an ordinary high school boy, and unless he kisses someone soon, she says, she will die. Seiji reluctantly kisses his crush, Akane Hiyama, a popular girl who turns out to be devoted to him to an alarming degree, and his everyday life fills up with chaotic romantic rivals. EMT Squared adapted Megane Mihoshi's web manga into 12 episodes in spring 2017. Contains fan service and slapstick violence.

dosanko-gyaru-wa-namaramenkoi.summary: Tsubasa Shiki is a high school boy who has just moved from Tokyo to Kitami, a city in Hokkaido, and he quickly learns that the winter there is much harsher than he imagined. Lost and freezing on his first day, he meets Minami Fuyuki, a chatty, outgoing gyaru who is wearing a short skirt despite the cold and who happily helps him find his way. Tsubasa soon discovers she is in his class, and Minami takes the city boy under her wing, showing him local food, slang and customs as he slowly falls for her. Silver Link and Blade adapted Kai Ikada's manga into 12 episodes in early 2024. Contains some fan service.

clevatess-majuu-no-ou-to-akago-to-kabane.summary: Clevatess is one of the four Beast Kings, monstrous lords who rule the lands beyond human territory. When a band of human heroes invades his domain, he wipes them out and then storms the human capital in revenge. Amid the ruins he is handed an unexpected burden: an infant from the kingdom's royal family. Curious about humanity rather than eager to destroy it, Clevatess decides to raise the baby, and he brings a fallen hero, Alicia Glenfall, back from the dead to serve as the child's caretaker. Lay-duce adapted Yuji Iwahara's manga into 12 episodes, aired from July to September 2025; a second season followed. Contains graphic violence.

engage-kiss.summary: Bayron City is an island metropolis built around a new energy source, and it is also plagued by demons that the authorities keep hidden from the public. Private military contractors are hired to deal with them. Shu Ogata runs one of these companies, but he is always broke, and his only employee is Kisara, a powerful demon who looks like a teenage girl and is fiercely attached to him. The two are bound by a contract, and Kisara is jealous of anyone who gets close to Shu. His ex-girlfriend Ayano, now an agent at a bigger firm, complicates things further. A-1 Pictures produced this 13-episode original series, written by Fumiaki Maruto, in summer 2022. Contains violence and fan service.

seishun-buta-yarou-daigakusei-hen.summary: Sakuta Azusagawa has followed his girlfriend, the actress Mai Sakurajima, to university and is settling into a new life of lectures, part-time work and new acquaintances. But the strange phenomena known as Adolescence Syndrome have not finished with him. His friend Uzuki Hirokawa, a cheerful member of the idol group Sweet Bullet, suddenly begins to behave differently, and her bandmate Nodoka Toyohama asks Sakuta to find out why. More odd incidents follow among the people around him at university. This season continues the Rascal Does Not Dream series, adapted from Hajime Kamoshida's light novels. CloverWorks produced its 13 episodes, aired from July to September 2025.

nige-jouzu-no-wakagimi.summary: In 1333, eight-year-old Hojo Tokiyuki is the heir of the clan that rules Japan from Kamakura, and he would rather play and run away from his lessons than learn swordsmanship. Then Ashikaga Takauji, the family's most trusted general, turns against them, and the Hojo regime falls almost overnight. Tokiyuki escapes with the help of Suwa Yorishige, an eccentric Shinto priest who believes the boy can reclaim the country. His only real talent, it turns out, is a remarkable gift for fleeing and hiding. CloverWorks adapted Yusei Matsui's manga, based on a real historical figure, into 12 episodes in summer 2024; a second season followed. Contains graphic violence.

ore-wa-subete-wo-parry-suru-gyaku-kanchi.summary: As a boy, Noor dreamed of becoming an adventurer, but when he arrived at the capital of the Kingdom of Clays, he was told he lacked the skills needed. The only technique he could learn was parrying. So he went home to the mountains and trained alone, and fifteen years later he returns, still convinced that he is weak and barely qualified. In reality, his endless training has made him absurdly strong. Soon after his return he saves Princess Lynneburg from an attack, and his modest misunderstandings keep pulling him into the kingdom's growing crisis. OLM adapted Nabeshiki's light novels into 12 episodes in summer 2024; a second season followed.

uma-musume-pretty-derby-tv.summary: In this world, famous racehorses of the past are reborn as horse girls, young women with horse ears and tails who are built to run. Special Week, an energetic girl from the countryside, travels to Tokyo to enrol at Tracen Academy, the elite school where horse girls train and compete in races. Inspired by the graceful star Silence Suzuka, she joins Suzuka's team, Spica, hoping to one day be the top racer in the country. P.A. Works adapted Cygames' multimedia franchise into 13 episodes in spring 2018; later seasons followed, and its sports drama is mixed with comedy.

working-1.summary: Souta Takanashi is a high school boy with a soft spot for anything small and cute. That is why he cannot say no when Popura Taneshima, a tiny girl who is actually his senior, asks him to work at Wagnaria, a family restaurant up in Hokkaido. The staff turns out to be very strange: floor chief Yachiyo Todoroki carries a katana everywhere, the cook Jun Sato is blunt and moody, and waitress Mahiru Inami has a fear of men that tends to hurt, usually Takanashi. Each episode is a workplace comedy about their daily shifts. A-1 Pictures adapted Karino Takatsu's four-panel manga into 13 episodes in spring 2010; two more seasons followed.

bubble.summary: Years ago, strange bubbles fell over the world and an explosion left Tokyo cut off from the rest of the world, flooded and full of gravity anomalies. The city has been abandoned, but groups of young people still live there and race one another across the ruins in parkour battles. Hibiki, a gifted but solitary member of one team, is unusually sensitive to sound and keeps hearing a mysterious tune. When he nearly drowns, he is rescued by Uta, a girl who seems to have no idea of how the world works. Wit Studio produced this film, directed by Tetsuro Araki from a script by Gen Urobuchi, released on Netflix in April 2022.

hagure-yuusha-no-estetica.summary: For decades, young people have been randomly pulled into other worlds, and the few who return bring back special powers. An organisation called Babel gathers these returnees and trains them at its academy. Akatsuki Ousawa is a notorious troublemaker among them: after saving the fantasy world of Alayzard, he came home to Earth with Miu, whose father was the demon king he defeated. To keep her identity secret, he passes her off as his little sister and enrols at the academy, where his reckless, arrogant behaviour quickly makes enemies. Arms adapted Tetsuto Uesu's light novels into 12 episodes, aired from July to September 2012. Contains heavy fan service and nudity.

chobits.summary: Hideki Motosuwa is a country boy who has moved to Tokyo to attend a prep school and study for university entrance exams. He has little money and longs for a persocom, a personal computer shaped like a human, which almost everyone in the city seems to own. One night he finds one lying among some rubbish bags, a beautiful girl with extremely long hair, and carries her home. When he switches her on, she seems to know nothing and can only say chii, so he names her Chii and starts teaching her about the world. Madhouse adapted CLAMP's manga into 26 episodes in 2002, directed by Morio Asaka. Contains sexual humour and fan service.

shingeki-no-bahamut-genesis.summary: Long ago in Mistarcia, a land where gods, demons and humans coexist, the ancient dragon Bahamut nearly destroyed everything, and gods and demons sealed it away by splitting the key between them. Two thousand years later, Favaro Leone is a carefree, self-serving bounty hunter who drifts from job to job, often pursued by Kaisar Lidfard, a righteous fellow bounty hunter determined to settle a score with him. Favaro's life changes when he meets Amira, a strange, innocent girl who asks him to guide her on a journey and who is tied to the seal on Bahamut. MAPPA adapted Cygames' card game Rage of Bahamut into 12 episodes, aired from October to December 2014. Contains fantasy violence.

tensei-oujo-to-tensai-reijou-no-mahou-ka.summary: In the kingdom of Palettia, magic marks the nobility, yet Princess Anisphia cannot use it at all. She has memories of a past life in a modern world, and she uses them to invent magical gadgets through a discipline she calls magicology, while dreaming of flying. Her eccentric ways have led her to give up her claim to the throne. One day, while testing a flying broom, she crashes in on the very moment her brother, Prince Algard, publicly breaks off his engagement to Euphyllia Magenta, a gifted noble daughter. Anis rescues Euphyllia and takes her on as an assistant. Diomedéa adapted Piero Karasu's light novels into 12 episodes in early 2023.

loop-7-kaime-no-akuyaku-reijou-wa-moto-t.summary: Rishe Irmgard Weitzner, daughter of a duke, is watching her crown prince fiancé call off their engagement in public for the seventh time. Each time it happens she has started a new life, working as a merchant, a knight and in other careers, but every time she has died at twenty in a war started by the neighbouring Galkhein Empire. This time she simply wants to relax. Then she meets Arnold Hein, Galkhein's crown prince, the man who killed her in a previous life, and he unexpectedly asks her to marry him. Rishe accepts, hoping to prevent the war from the inside. Studio KAI and Hornets adapted Touko Amekawa's light novels into 12 episodes in early 2024.

danganronpa-3-the-end-of-kibougamine-gak.summary: After escaping the killing game at Hope's Peak Academy, Makoto Naegi joined the Future Foundation, a group working to rebuild a world wrecked by despair. Now he has been arrested and put on trial by its leaders for sheltering the Remnants of Despair. During the hearing, the executives, along with Naegi, Kyoko Kirigiri and Aoi Asahina, are trapped in a building and forced into a new killing game, each with a secret forbidden action that will be fatal if broken. This Future Arc, by Lerche, aired in 12 episodes in summer 2016, alternating weekly with the Despair Arc, and continues the story of Spike Chunsoft's video games. Contains graphic violence and gore.

isekai-yakkyoku.summary: Kanji Yakutani was a brilliant Japanese pharmacologist who devoted his life to developing new medicines after losing his younger sister to illness. He works himself to death at thirty-one and wakes up in a medieval-style world as Falma de Médicis, the ten-year-old son of a respected medical family. Medicine there is backward and mostly reserved for the rich, and Falma discovers that he has been blessed with divine powers that help him identify and create substances. Using his knowledge of modern science, he sets out to change how the sick are treated and eventually opens a pharmacy. Diomedéa adapted Liz Takayama's light novels into 12 episodes in summer 2022.

suki-na-ko-ga-megane-wo-wasureta.summary: Kaede Komura is a shy high school boy who has fallen hard for Ai Mie, the girl at the desk next to his. He has barely spoken to her, but he loves how she looks in her glasses. A few days after they become deskmates, he notices her squinting and realises she has left her glasses at home, something that turns out to happen all the time. Ai's eyesight is so poor that she struggles through the day, and Komura keeps stepping in to help, often ending up much closer to her than his nerves can handle. GoHands adapted Koume Fujichika's manga into 13 episodes in summer 2023. It is a light, sweet romantic comedy.

tokyo-godfathers.summary: On Christmas Eve in Tokyo, three homeless people are digging through rubbish when they discover an abandoned newborn baby. Gin is a middle-aged drinker with a vague past, Hana is a sentimental transgender woman who has always wanted to be a mother, and Miyuki is a teenage girl who ran away from home. Hana names the baby Kiyoko and refuses to hand her to the police, insisting they find the parents themselves and ask why she was left. With only a key and a few clues to go on, the trio set off across the snowy city, running into a chain of coincidences. Satoshi Kon wrote and directed this 2003 Madhouse film. Contains some violence.

edens-zero.summary: Shiki Granbell has grown up as the only human on Granbell, an abandoned amusement park planet, raised by kindly robots and able to control gravity with a power called Ether Gear. When Rebecca Bluegarden, a young video creator, and her talking blue cat Happy land there looking for content for their channel, they are the first visitors in a hundred years. Shiki is thrilled to make friends, and after the three are forced to leave the planet, he joins them on a voyage across the Sakura Cosmos in search of Mother, a legendary goddess of the universe. J.C.Staff adapted Hiro Mashima's manga into 25 episodes in 2021; a second season followed.

yumemiru-danshi-wa-genjitsushugisha.summary: Wataru Sajou has spent years chasing his classmate Aika Natsukawa, following her around and declaring his love every day, even though she always turns him down. One morning, after a sudden moment of clarity, he decides he is simply not good enough for her and that his behaviour has been a nuisance. So he stops. Wataru steps back, treats Aika politely like any other classmate and spends his time with friends and other girls instead. Aika, who had grown used to his attention, is confused and assumes he now dislikes her, and she starts paying attention to him for the first time. Studio Gokumi and AXsiZ adapted Okemaru's light novels into 12 episodes in summer 2023.

noucome-my-mental-choices-are-completely.summary: High schooler Kanade Amakusa lives under a ridiculous curse called Absolute Choice. At random moments, two or three options appear in his head, and he must pick one and act it out immediately, no matter how embarrassing. The choices are almost always absurd or indecent, and they have wrecked his reputation at school. One day, a choice involving something falling from the sky sends a pretty blonde girl named Chocolat crashing into him. She claims to have been sent by a god to help him lift the curse, and Kanade hopes she might finally fix his life. Diomedéa adapted Takeru Kasukabe's light novels into 10 episodes in late 2013. Contains frequent sexual humour and fan service.

rurouni-kenshin.summary: In 1878, ten years after the wars that brought in the Meiji era, the most feared swordsman of the revolution, a killer known as Hitokiri Battosai, has vanished. In his place is Kenshin Himura, a gentle, red-haired wanderer who has sworn never to kill again and carries a sword with its blade on the wrong side. In Tokyo he meets Kaoru Kamiya, a young woman trying to keep her late father's sword school alive while someone commits murders under Battosai's name. Kenshin stays at her dojo, but enemies from his past keep finding him. Studio Gallop and Studio Deen adapted Nobuhiro Watsuki's manga into 94 episodes from 1996 to 1998. Contains sword violence.

grisaia-no-rakuen.summary: This is the direct continuation of The Labyrinth of Grisaia and the final part of the anime adaptation of the Grisaia visual novels, so it is meant to be watched after The Fruit of Grisaia and Labyrinth. Yuji Kazami, the transfer student at the tiny Mihama Academy, has been taken into custody on suspicion of terrorism. Ichigaya, the agency that once used his skills, knows he is innocent but has its own plans for him. The girls of Mihama Academy refuse to abandon him and decide to act on their own. 8bit adapted Frontwing's visual novel into 10 episodes in spring 2015. Contains violence, sexual content and disturbing themes, including child abuse.
grisaia-no-rakuen.notes: Premise detail (Yuji's arrest, the girls' rescue effort) is from MyAnimeList/AniList/Kitsu synopses, which share one text; Wikipedia only confirms the anime exists and its studio/run.

rainbow-nisha-rokubou-no-shichinin.summary: In 1955, six teenage boys convicted of serious crimes are sent to the Shonan Special Reformatory and locked in the same cell. There they meet Rokurouta Sakuragi, an older inmate and former boxer, who becomes a protective big brother to them and teaches them to stand together. Inside, the boys face cruelty from a sadistic guard and a doctor who abuses the inmates, and they promise one another to survive and meet again once they are free. The story follows them in prison and in the hard years of post-war Japan that come after. Madhouse adapted George Abe and Masasumi Kakizaki's manga into 26 episodes in 2010. Contains graphic violence and depictions of sexual abuse.

jormungand.summary: Jonah is a quiet boy who grew up as a child soldier and despises weapons and the people who sell them. Even so, he ends up as a bodyguard for Koko Hekmatyar, a young, cheerful and ruthless arms dealer working for HCLI, a huge international shipping company. Koko travels the world selling weapons to governments and armies, dodging rivals, spies and assassins, and she is protected by a team of hardened former soldiers. Jonah joins them on missions across many countries while trying to understand Koko and her mysterious talk of world peace. White Fox adapted Keitaro Takahashi's manga into 12 episodes in spring 2012; a second season followed soon after. Contains graphic violence.

amagami-ss.summary: Two years ago, Junichi Tachibana was stood up on a Christmas Eve date, and ever since he has avoided romance and grown to dislike the holiday. Now a second-year high school student, he gets another chance as Christmas approaches. The series is told as an omnibus: each arc, a few episodes long, follows Junichi falling for a different girl, from the popular senior Haruka Morishima and his childhood friend Kaoru Tanamachi to the shy Sae Nakata, swimmer Ai Nanasaki, sweets-loving Rihoko Sakurai and the class representative Tsukasa Ayatsuji. Each arc resets the story. AIC adapted Enterbrain's dating sim into 25 episodes in 2010. Contains some fan service.

danganronpa-3-the-end-of-kibougamine-gak.summary: Set years before the events of the first Danganronpa game, this arc returns to Hope's Peak Academy, a school for students with extraordinary talents. Class 77-B, a noisy group of gifted teenagers, gets a new homeroom teacher, Chisa Yukizome, a cheerful former student known as the Ultimate Housekeeper, who sets out to pull the unruly class together. Meanwhile, Hajime Hinata, an ordinary student in the school's paying Reserve Course, wishes desperately that he had a gift of his own, until he meets the gamer Chiaki Nanami. Lerche produced this 11-episode Despair Arc in summer 2016, alternating weekly with the Future Arc; it continues the story of Spike Chunsoft's games. Contains graphic violence and disturbing themes.

just-because.summary: It is the final term of high school, and the third-year students are drifting toward graduation and the future. Mio Natsume is quietly holding on to old feelings, Haruto Soma spends his time on baseball, and Hazuki Morikawa plays in the concert band. Second-year Ena Komiya is fighting to keep the photography club from being shut down. Then Eita Izumi, a boy whose family has moved constantly for his father's work, transfers back into his hometown school for the last few months. His return stirs up old friendships and feelings among people he knew before. PINE JAM produced this 12-episode original series, written by Hajime Kamoshida, from October to December 2017.

yuru-yuri.summary: Akari Akaza has just started middle school at an all-girls school, where she rejoins her childhood friends Kyoko Toshino and Yui Funami. The two older girls have founded the Amusement Club, which has no real purpose and meets in the old tea ceremony club's room. Akari joins, and soon a classmate, Chinatsu Yoshikawa, wanders in thinking it is still the tea club and ends up staying. The four spend their days chatting, playing and getting into silly situations, often alongside the members of the student council. Doga Kobo adapted Namori's manga into 12 episodes in summer 2011. It is a gentle comedy with light romantic teasing between the girls.

koori-no-joheki.summary: Koyuki Hikawa is a high school girl whom most classmates find cold and intimidating. In truth she is anxious and prone to overthinking, because of painful experiences in middle school, and she keeps people at a distance to protect herself. Her only close friend is the cheerful Miki Azumi. Then she meets Minato Amamiya, a friendly boy who does not seem bothered by her prickly manner and keeps trying to get to know her, along with his friend Yota Hino. Slowly, the four start spending time together. Studio KAI adapted Koucha Agasawa's web manga into 14 episodes, aired from April to July 2026. It is a quiet, realistic school romance.

eureka-seven.summary: Fourteen-year-old Renton Thurston lives in the dull town of Bellforest with his grandfather, a mechanic who wants him to follow in his footsteps. Renton dreams of adventure and spends his free time riding the Trapar waves that fill the air, a sport much like surfing, and idolises the Gekkostate, a famous mercenary crew whose members are skilled wave riders. One day a mecha called the Nirvash typeZERO crashes into his garage. Its pilot is Eureka, a mysterious girl from the Gekkostate, and meeting her pulls Renton into the crew and a much bigger conflict. Bones produced this 50-episode original series, directed by Tomoki Kyoda, from 2005 to 2006.

katainaka-no-ossan-kensei-ni-naru.summary: Beryl Gardenant is a modest swordsman in his forties who has spent twenty years teaching at his father's small dojo in a backwater village. He thinks of himself as an unremarkable old man. One day Allucia Citrus, a former pupil who now commands the kingdom's order of knights, arrives with an appointment for him to become a special instructor in the capital. Reluctantly, Beryl goes, and keeps running into other old students who have become famous fighters, adventurers and mages, all of whom regard him as a master. Only Beryl seems unaware of how strong he really is. Passione and Hayabusa Film adapted Shigeru Sagazaki's light novels into 12 episodes in spring 2025; a second season followed.

trigun-stampede.summary: On the desert planet No Man's Land, where humanity's survivors scrape by around ageing energy plants, the gunman Vash the Stampede is a wanted man with an enormous bounty on his head. A young reporter, Meryl Stryfe, and her veteran partner Roberto De Niro set out to track him down for a story. The man they find is nothing like his legend: a cheerful, goofy pacifist who hates killing and seems to attract disaster wherever he goes. As they follow him, they learn his past is tied to his twin brother, Knives. Studio Orange made this reimagined adaptation of Yasuhiro Nightow's manga, 12 episodes in early 2023; a sequel, Trigun Stargaze, followed. Contains violence.

keikenzumi-na-kimi-to-keiken-zero-na-ore.summary: Ryuto Kashima is a quiet, gloomy high school boy who loses a game with his friends and, as a penalty, has to confess to Runa Shirakawa, a bubbly, fashionable girl at the top of the school's social ladder. To his shock, she says yes, simply because she happens to be single at the moment. On their very first date she invites him to her room, and they quickly realise their ideas about dating could hardly be more different, since she has had several boyfriends and he has never even held hands. The two try to learn how to be a couple anyway. ENGI adapted Makiko Nagaoka's light novels into 12 episodes in late 2023. Contains frank discussion of sexual experience.

nanbaka.summary: Nanba Prison is the most secure jail in the world, built to hold criminals no ordinary prison can keep. Its Cell 13 houses four young inmates who have escaped from every other prison they have been sent to: Jyugo, a lock-picking expert with a mysterious past; Uno, a gambler who loves women; Rock, a big brawler who lives for food; and Nico, a cheerful otaku. Their guard, Hajime Sugoroku, has his hands full keeping them inside, while the four turn prison life into a string of escape attempts, games and contests with other buildings. Satelight adapted Sho Futamata's web manga into 13 episodes in late 2016; a second season followed. It is a colourful action comedy.

afro-samurai.summary: In a stylised world that mixes feudal Japan with modern technology and hip hop, whoever wears the Number One headband is said to have the power of a god. The only person allowed to challenge the Number One is whoever holds the Number Two headband, and anyone at all may challenge the Number Two. As a child, Afro watched his father, the Number One, killed in a duel by a gunman named Justice. Now a silent, grown swordsman wearing the Number Two band, Afro travels toward Justice while a steady stream of killers comes after him. Gonzo adapted Takashi Okazaki's manga into a five-episode series in 2007. Contains extremely graphic violence and some nudity.

omoide-no-marnie.summary: Anna Sasaki is a twelve-year-old girl in Sapporo who keeps to herself, feels she does not belong anywhere and is troubled by asthma. Her worried foster mother sends her to spend the summer with relatives, a kind older couple who live in a quiet seaside village where the air is clean. Anna passes the days sketching and avoiding the local children. Across a salt marsh she notices an old, empty mansion that seems strangely familiar, and there she meets Marnie, a blonde girl who quickly becomes her secret friend. Hiromasa Yonebayashi directed this 2014 Studio Ghibli film, adapted from an English novel of 1967 by Joan G. Robinson. It is a gentle, emotional drama suitable for families.

d-frag.summary: Kenji Kazama thinks of himself as a tough delinquent and leads a small gang of two friends at his high school. On their first day back, they help put out a fire in the room of the Game Creation Club, but instead of thanking them, the club's eccentric girls knock out his friends and drag Kenji into joining. The members each claim an elemental power and make up their own strange rules, and Kenji, who turns out to be the only sensible one, spends every day reacting to their nonsense. Most episodes are fast-paced, loosely connected comedy sketches. Brain's Base adapted Tomoya Haruno's manga into 12 episodes, aired from January to March 2014.

girls-und-panzer.summary: In this world, sensha-do, the art of fighting with World War II tanks, is a respected traditional sport for young women, and high schools field teams that battle with blank shells. Miho Nishizumi comes from a famous sensha-do family but transfers to Oarai Girls' High School, a school built on a huge ship, specifically because it has no tank team. Then the student council announces it is reviving the sport and pressures Miho to join. With new friends and a mismatched collection of old tanks, she ends up leading a team of beginners into the national tournament. Actas produced this 12-episode original series, directed by Tsutomu Mizushima, from 2012 to 2013.

tada-kun-wa-koi-wo-shinai.summary: Mitsuyoshi Tada is a calm high school boy who loves photography and has never been interested in romance. One spring day, while taking pictures of cherry blossoms, he meets Teresa Wagner, a cheerful young woman from the small European country of Larsenburg who has lost track of her travel companion. Tada helps her and brings her back to the café run by his grandfather. Their paths keep crossing, and it turns out Teresa is transferring into his class, along with her strict bodyguard Alec. Bright, curious and fond of Japanese anime, she slowly livens up Tada's quiet life. Doga Kobo produced this 13-episode original romantic comedy in spring 2018.

tensei-kenja-no-isekai-life-dai-2-no-sho.summary: Yuji Sano is an exhausted office worker at a harsh company who suddenly finds himself transported into a world that works like a video game. There he is given the Monster Tamer class, considered the weakest of all. Yuji tames a large group of slimes, and with their help he gains enormous magical knowledge and picks up a second class, Sage, which quickly makes him one of the strongest people in the world. Even so, he has no wish to be a hero and would rather live quietly with his ever-growing family of slimes, who turn out to be surprisingly useful. Revoroot adapted Shinkoshoto's light novels into 12 episodes in summer 2022.

tensei-kizoku-no-isekai-boukenroku-jicho.summary: Kazuya Shiina is stabbed to death in Japan while trying to protect two girls from an attacker. As a reward, he is reborn in a fantasy world with his memories intact, now named Cain von Silford and born the youngest of three sons in a noble house. At a ceremony when he turns five, he meets the seven gods who rule this world, and each one happily showers him with blessings, leaving him with absurdly high stats and powers he must hide from everyone. Cain grows up trying to act normal, which proves difficult as his talents keep showing. Magic Bus and EMT Squared adapted Yashu's light novels into 12 episodes in spring 2023. Contains some fan service.

kaminaki-sekai-no-kamisama-katsudou.summary: Yukito Urabe is the son of a cult leader in Japan, and during a ritual meant to make him the cult's new head, he drowns. As he dies he wishes to be reborn somewhere without gods or religion, and he wakes up in a world where nobody has ever believed in a deity. He is welcomed into a village by Aruaru, a lively young woman, but soon finds that this world has dark problems of its own. Yukito decides that perhaps it needs faith after all, and begins to create a religion around Mitama, the god his father's cult worshipped. Studio Palette adapted Aoi Akashiro's manga into 12 episodes in 2023. Contains violence and sexual content.

osananajimi-ga-zettai-ni-makenai-love-co.summary: Sueharu Maru is a high school boy who lives next door to his childhood friend Kuroha Shida, a cute, caring girl who acts like a big sister and is very popular. When Kuroha confesses her feelings, Sueharu turns her down on the spot, because he is in love with Shirokusa Kachi, a beautiful, aloof classmate who is also an award-winning novelist. Sueharu believes he has a chance with her, until he learns she already has a boyfriend. While he is heartbroken, Kuroha comes to him with an unexpected proposal: let's get revenge. A full-blown romantic rivalry follows. Doga Kobo adapted Shuichi Nimaru's light novels into 12 episodes in spring 2021.

uramichi-oniisan.summary: Uramichi Omota is a thirty-one-year-old former gymnast who leads the exercise segment on a cheerful morning children's TV show. On camera he smiles, but he is worn out by adult life, and he keeps letting bleak, honest remarks about work, money and loneliness slip out in front of the young kids. His co-workers are no better off: singer Utano Tadano mainly wants to get married, fellow singer Iketeru Daga is handsome but crude, and the people inside the cuddly bear and rabbit costumes have their own troubles. Each episode is a deadpan workplace comedy about adulthood. Studio Blanc adapted Gaku Kuze's web manga into 13 episodes in summer 2021.

ballroom-e-youkoso.summary: Tatara Fujita is a third-year middle school student who has no idea what he wants to do with his life and tends to go along with whatever happens. When some delinquents try to take his money, he is rescued by Kaname Sengoku, a professional ballroom dancer who rides a motorcycle and runs on charisma. Sengoku drags Tatara into the Ogasawara Dance Studio, where Tatara watches Shizuku Hanaoka, a talented girl from his school, dance and is captivated. For the first time, he finds something he wants to throw himself into, despite starting far behind everyone else. Production I.G adapted Tomo Takeuchi's manga into 24 episodes, aired from July to December 2017.

dakara-boku-wa-h-ga-dekinai.summary: Ryosuke Kaga is an openly lecherous high school boy, which has made him an outcast in class. Mina Okura, who grew up with him, is the one person who sees that underneath it he is kind and genuinely protective of girls. One rainy day he meets Lisara Restall, a proud Grim Reaper from a noble family who has come to the human world to find someone called the Singular Man. To stay in this world she needs energy, and the source she draws on is Ryosuke's lust. He agrees to a contract and joins her search, at real risk to his life. Feel. adapted Pan Tachibana's light novels into 12 episodes in summer 2012. Contains heavy sexual content and nudity.

choujin-koukousei-tachi-wa-isekai-demo-y.summary: Seven Japanese high school students are each world-famous: among them are Tsukasa Mikogami, a teenage politician who serves as prime minister, the inventor Ringo Ohoshi, the doctor Keine Kanzaki, a sword master, a magician, a journalist and a business tycoon. When their plane crashes, they wake up in Freyjagard, a feudal fantasy world where people with animal traits and ordinary humans live under harsh noble rule. They are rescued by a villager named Winona and her adopted daughter Lyrule, and to repay them, the seven start using modern knowledge to change village life, and eventually much more. Project No.9 adapted Riku Misora's light novels into 12 episodes in late 2019.

kumicho-musume-to-sewagakari.summary: Toru Kirishima is a feared enforcer in the Sakuragi yakuza family, known in the underworld as the Demon of Sakuragi because of how quickly he turns to violence. After his recklessness nearly ruins a peace deal with another group, the family boss gives him an unusual new duty: looking after his seven-year-old daughter, Yaeka. Yaeka rarely shows her feelings, and Kirishima has no idea how to care for a child, so the two struggle to understand each other at first. Slowly, school runs, meals and outings turn the pair into an unlikely, warm duo. Feel. and Gaina adapted Tsukiya's web manga into 12 episodes in summer 2022. Contains some violence.

koi-wa-sekai-seifuku-no-ato-de.summary: Fudo Aikawa is Red Gelato, who leads Gelato 5, a squad of costumed heroes protecting Japan. Desumi Magahara, called the Reaper Princess, is a top fighter for Gekko, the evil secret society trying to conquer the world. On the battlefield they are sworn enemies, but they have secretly just started dating. Both are sweet, awkward and inexperienced, and they have to slip away mid-fight for quick dates while hiding the relationship from their teammates and bosses. The series spoofs Super Sentai-style hero shows while telling a simple love story. Project No.9 adapted the manga by Hiroshi Noda and Takahiro Wakamatsu into 12 episodes in spring 2022. Contains some fan service.

texhnolyze.summary: Lux is a decaying city deep underground, cut off from the surface and run by competing factions, chief among them the Organo crime syndicate. The city exists to mine raffia, a mineral used to make texhnolyze, advanced prosthetic limbs. Ichise, a silent prizefighter, offends the wrong person and has an arm and a leg cut off. Left for dead, he is saved by a doctor who fits him with experimental texhnolyze limbs. As he recovers, a stranger from the surface stirs trouble among the gangs, and Ichise is drawn into the city's power struggles, alongside Ran, a girl who can see the future. Madhouse produced this 22-episode original series in 2003. Contains extremely graphic violence and bleak, disturbing themes.

ano-natsu-de-matteru.summary: One summer night, Kaito Kirishima is trying out a camera from a bridge when a blue light shoots across the sky and he is thrown off the railing. He wakes up in his own bed the next morning, unhurt and unable to remember what happened. Soon after, he and his friends decide to use the camera to shoot an amateur film over the summer holidays. His friend Tetsuro invites Ichika Takatsuki, a mysterious older student Kaito is drawn to, and her friend Remon. As filming goes on, feelings within the group grow complicated. J.C.Staff produced this 12-episode original series in early 2012, directed by Tatsuyuki Nagai. Contains some fan service.

hitsugi-no-chaika.summary: Five years ago, a long war ended when the Eight Heroes killed Arthur Gaz, the ruthless emperor of the Gaz Empire. Toru Acura is a saboteur trained for that war, and now that peace has come, he has no idea what to do with his skills or his life. While foraging in a forest, he meets Chaika Trabant, a white-haired wizard who carries a large coffin on her back. She hires Toru and Akari, his adoptive sister, to help gather her late father's remains, which are spread across the land, so she can bury him properly, a quest that soon draws dangerous attention. Bones adapted Ichiro Sakaki's light novels into 12 episodes in spring 2014; a second season followed.

nozomanu-fushi-no-boukensha.summary: Rentt Faina has been an adventurer for ten years and is still only Bronze class, but he keeps going, hoping to reach Mithril class one day. While exploring a well-known labyrinth, he stumbles into an undiscovered passage that leads to a dragon, which devours him. Rentt then wakes up as a skeleton, the weakest kind of undead monster. He discovers that by defeating other monsters he can evolve into stronger, more human-like forms, so he sets out to keep evolving until he can return to human society and resume his life as an adventurer. Connect adapted Yu Okano's light novels into 12 episodes in early 2024; a second season followed. Contains violence.

ansatsusha-de-aru-ore-no-status-ga-yuush.summary: Akira Oda is a quiet, sensible high school boy who is summoned with his entire class to the Kingdom of Retice in a world that works like a role-playing game. Each student receives a class and stats, and while his classmate Tsukasa Sato is named the hero, Akira is labelled an assassin. Checking the numbers, Akira realises his stats are far higher than the hero's. The king urges the students to fight the demon king, but Akira suspects he is not being told the truth, so he hides his strength and starts quietly investigating what is really going on. Sunrise adapted Matsuri Akai's light novels into 12 episodes between October and December 2025. Contains violence.

yu-gi-oh-duel-monsters.summary: Yugi Mutou is a timid, game-loving high school boy who lives above his grandfather's game shop. For years he has been working on the Millennium Puzzle, an ancient Egyptian artefact said to grant a wish, and he hopes to wish for real friends. When he finally completes it, a mysterious, far bolder spirit begins to share his body and steps in whenever Yugi or his friends are in danger. Meanwhile, the card game Duel Monsters is sweeping the world, and Yugi's skill draws the attention of Seto Kaiba, a cold teenage billionaire and undefeated duelist. Studio Gallop adapted Kazuki Takahashi's manga into 224 episodes from 2000 to 2004, with several spin-off series following.
